articleTitle: 0.18 /spl mu/m CMOS sub-harmonic mixer for 2.4 GHz IEEE802.15.4 transceiver
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: This work describes a sub-harmonic mixer designed in a 0.18 /spl mu/m CMOS process and intended for use in a low-power IEEE 802.15.4-compliant 2.4 GHz transceiver. The device addresses the following issues of the direct conversion architecture: flicker-noise, LO leakage and oscillator pulling.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Lorenz lemma with the influence of exchange interaction and propagation of the magnetostatic waves with higher diffraction and dispersion
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: An efficient method (nonlinear Lorenz lemma) for the derivation of a reduced 2D evolution equation for the nonlinear magnetostatic waves in ferrite films is developed. The method describes wave propagation in the media with spatial dispersion (caused by exchange interaction in ferrites). Higher linear and nonlinear terms are included in the evolution equation. Numerical computations show that nonlinear diffraction and dispersion affect considerably pulse propagation for sufficiently large input pulse amplitudes and distances from the input antenna.

articleTitle: Impact of microwave radiation on vegetable biological objects
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Among physical methods for the presowing treatment of seeds electromagnetic irradiation deserves special attention. The frequencies of the cell membrane vibrations of biological objects lie in the mm-wave range. Mm-waves are known to be immanent to any living organism. The mm-wave irradiation of bioobjects initiates resonant phenomena in living cells and has an overall positive impact on biological organisms. The effect of electromagnetic fields on the germination of dill seeds is discussed. An optimal dose for the seed irradiation has been derived.

articleTitle: A monolithic 2.4 GHz, 0.13 /spl mu/m CMOS power amplifier with 28 dBm output power and 48% PAE at 1.2 V supply
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A two stage differential (push-pull) Class AB power amplifier for 2.4 GHz has been realized in a 0.13 /spl mu/m standard CMOS technology. A microstrip line matching network was used for the impedance transformation. A maximum output power of 28 dBm was achieved at 1.2 V supply voltage and 48% power added efficiency. The small signal gain is 26 dB.

articleTitle: The search method of natural disaster victims
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The problem of searching for victims after a natural disaster is important for Ukraine because of the frequent accidents at coal mines. A method for searching for people trapped under the rock or ice after a natural disaster, which combines the usage of a low frequency technique, as well as a microwave one, is discussed.

articleTitle: Groundbreaking helix slow-wave structures with diamond heat sinks for power TWTs
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The helical slow-wave structure (HSWS) is the pioneering and prevailing type of slow-wave structure for traveling-wave tubes. One serious drawback found in the conventional HSWS is low heat removal, which limits tube output power. Attempts at improving heat removal by employing soldered helixes or support rods made of beryllium oxide or diamonds usually result in very complicated production processes and higher costs. Apart from that, the net effect is less than expected. For diamond support rods this is due in particular to the small surface and large thermal resistance in the area of the helix in contact with the rod. We propose a new design and technology for manufacturing HSWS employing CVD diamonds. The proposed design offers excellent thermal properties and high interaction impedance over extensive bandwidths.

articleTitle: Master oscillator for Ka-band communication systems
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A Ka-band PLL master oscillator for communication systems is considered. It consists of 12-12.5 GHz frequency synthesizer and multiplier, based on a monolithic IC, AMMC5040. As a result, a master oscillator at 36-37.5 GHz has been developed. The tuning range is about 350 MHz, with a 3.5 MHz step, so that four options of the oscillator are needed to cover the whole frequency band 36-37.5 GHz.

articleTitle: Experimental evaluation of lossy coatings of different materials on helix support rods for a high-efficient TWT
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: All reflections present in the device may cause oscillations and hence instability in a high efficiency traveling wave tube (TWT) amplifier. In a helix TWT, a coating of lossy material is deposited on the helix support rods to absorb these reflections. Carbon is a very commonly used material for this type of coating, and may be deposited by a number of techniques. But other materials may also be employed for this purpose. In the present work, coatings of carbon, nickel and iron have been made and evaluated for their attenuation performance at microwave frequencies. Three APBN rods have been coated with carbon in different thicknesses by a pyrolytic deposition method, while two rods of alumina have been coated with an electro-deposition method. An experimental set-up involving a narrow-height wave-guide with a hole was used to measure the attenuation of the coated rods at 6.0 GHz. Very significant results have been obtained in the experimental study and it is concluded that carbon coated rods have maximum attenuation but nickel and iron can be used also for attenuator purposes.

articleTitle: Results of reflection loss measurements of sample material for radio astronomy telescope antenna for Planck Project
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Advanced radio telescope antennas for space applications are realised by the use of stable composite materials, which are lighter in general than various metal realisations. Reflectivity measurements have been carried out on high technology samples for the Planck radio telescope. Highly accurate results have been obtained at the Applied Physics Institute in Nizhny Novgorod, and an independent measurement with a totally different setup at the University of Stuttgart confirmed that one of the samples showed a strange behaviour. Moreover, it confirmed the high accuracy of the testing method.

articleTitle: Design of high efficiency space TWTs
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: High efficiency space travelling wave tubes (TWT) are essentially required for defense coherent radars and for satellite communication systems as a high power, high gain microwave amplifier. High efficiency (more than 60%) and high linearity (phase shift less than 30/spl deg/) are very important aspects of a space TWT. Since 1997, efforts have been made at CEERI (jointly with BEL, Bangalore) for the successful design and development of high efficiency TWTs for space applications. Two projects have been sponsored by ISRO, Bangalore. A C-band 60 W space TWT has been successfully designed and prototypes have been developed jointly with BEL. Desired RF and electrical specifications were achieved over an extended frequency range of 3.40 GHz to 4.20 GHz with an output power more than 60 W, large-signal gain more than 50 dB, overall efficiency more than 55%, AM/PM factor less than 4 degrees/dB, and harmonic components and intermodulation (I/M) components more than 12 dBc down. Agreements between the simulated and the experimental values of the AM/PM factor, I/M components and the second harmonic power were achieved well within 10%. 'Quality assurance' (QA) of the C-band 60 W TWT has been initiated for space qualification. The design of a radiation-cooled Ku-band 140 W space TWT has recently been completed and the design has been transferred to BEL for further joint development.

articleTitle: Ultra wideband transistor microwave chaotic oscillators
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: An approach to the design of chaotic oscillators with controlled bandwidth in different frequency bands is proposed. Mathematical models of the oscillator and simulation results are considered. Implementations of microwave chaotic oscillators and experimental results are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Orbotrons: multibeam MM- and sub-MM-wave oscillators
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A number of factors limit the electron efficiency of free-electron maser (FEM) orotrons. Some of these issues have been resolved by a new design of a multibeam FEM orbotron (Open Resonator, Binary comb, O-Type, electRON). Results of investigating FEM orbotrons with spatially developed (multiple-beam) electron streams are presented. A possibility is demonstrated of improving the power characteristics of millimeter-wave multiple-beam tubes while reducing their overall dimensions and weight.

articleTitle: Wideband noise radar for detection of slow moving objects
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The results of the theoretical and experimental researches of L-band short-range radar, with correlation processing of random noise sounding waveforms, are presented. It proposes the approach of inter-survey subtraction of clutters to detect and localize slow moving objects.

articleTitle: Satellite modem for small corporate data transmission networks
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The target setting of the main requirements for satellite modems used in construction of a small corporate network for data transmission is discussed. A list of functions, and also the main characteristics and parameters are stated.

articleTitle: The analysis of increase a noise stability by wireless information system
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: We look at the analysis and synthesis of a system to define the average capacity of a handicap, not orthogonal in relation to an information signal, for increase of the relation "signal/noise" in wireless digital communication.

articleTitle: Organization and economical aspects of satellite networks with asymmetric Internet access
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: We discuss the organization, technical and economical aspects of satellite Internet networks with asymmetrical access, which puts up creation and operation costs. There are two existing methods of upstream channel creation for satellite Internet networks with asymmetric access. The first is the satellite upstream channel, and the second is PSTN or leased lines. The price of the satellite terminal system depends on the following elements: (1) antenna system; (2) cross-polarization value; (3) output power of transmitter and receiver sensitivity; (4) installation and setup; (5) license. These systems can be widely used only when the licensing scheme is simpler. It would be reasonable to follow the example of Europe and Russia as soon as possible.

articleTitle: Forced and own waves of coupled cavity periodic structure
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The results are presented of an investigation of the forced waves of a coupled cavity periodic structure of final length, i.e., results of research of forced waves in slow wave structures with inductive coupled cavities. The results establish the character of the change of the field amplitude and phase distribution of the system on the forced wave frequencies that are not equal to the self frequencies of the system. For the estimation of the efficiency of interaction of an electron beam with the field of a coupled cavity periodic structure with the transitional matching arrangement in a wide band of frequencies, it is necessary to take into account not only the character, but also the value, of change of distribution of amplitude and phase of a field on the length of system by propagation to its own and, especially, the forced waves.

articleTitle: Autodyne UHF geoinformation system on the base of planar Gunn diodes
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The paper presents the results of a theoretical analysis of an autodyne UHF geoinformation system (GIS), using a multifunction crystal with N mesaplanar structures as an active element. We considered a continuous mode of GIS operation for polyharmonic generation, with the GIS being radiated by its native reflected radiation at each harmonic. We obtained the basic ratios for autodyne response analysis. Further improvements of autodyne systems are concerned mainly with the introduction of the UHF band and the creation of hybrid ICs for this band. It seems that there is a good prospect in investigating the autodyne characteristics of UHF oscillators, created on the basis of a fundamentally new structure of GIS active element. This is a multifunction Gunn diode with low current drain in the feed network, which is incorporated into the resonant section of a coplanar microstrip transmission line. A conclusion has been made regarding the peculiarities of self-oscillation of such autodyne systems.

articleTitle: Wideband digital communication system with spectral processing of noise waveforms
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: We propose a digital communication system on the basis of double spectral processing of ultra wideband (UWB) noise waveforms. The structure of the spectral modulator of UWB noise waveforms is presented for digital information transmission. The spectral modulator performs the code transformation of the UWB noise spectrum by means of simple delay lines. The basis of UWB noise waveforms having periodic spectral modulation is defined as the product of the frequency bandwidth and the duration of a binary information symbol. The spectral compression of UWB noise waveforms with an information rate is discussed. It is shown that digital communication systems with double spectral processing of UWB noise waveforms have a high immunity against electromagnetic interference. The excellent electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) and low probability of intercept (LPI) performance characterize the proposed digital communication system. This work has been carried out with partial support by the Russian Foundation for Basic Research.

articleTitle: Coupling coefficients of resonators in microstrip model of superlattice
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The frequency-dependent coupling coefficients of resonators in the microstrip model of a superlattice were investigated. These coefficients near to the natural frequencies of the structure coincide with coefficients that are calculated by known methods. The calculation corresponds with experimental results obtained for microstrip structures.

articleTitle: Calculation and analysis of the gyromagnetic bandpass filter operation on the rectangular waveguides in multifrequency behavior
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: An electrodynamic method is used in the calculations for a gyromagnetic microwave bandpass filter in multifrequency behavior, taking into account the influence of the higher types of magnetization precession.

articleTitle: Passive multichannel millimeter-wave imaging system
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A passive 32-channel imaging system, operating in the 8-mm wave band, has been developed at SRC "Iceberg" during the last two years. The system consists of a focal plane array connected to a processor, quasi-optical antenna, and scanning mechanism. The system provides a 90/spl times/16 degrees field-of-view, and displays the acquired image within 3 seconds.

articleTitle: The principles of realization and application range of homodyne measuring methods
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Homodyne methods of amplitude and phase measurement are presented. The range of applications of the homodyne method is also discussed.

articleTitle: Phase modulator on the base of ferroelectric varactors
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The paper presents results of measurements of both MW small signal characteristics and the response to voltage pulses for an L-band phase modulator. The modulator contains lumped (Ba,Sr)TiO/sub 3/ film-based capacitors.

articleTitle: New technology of fabrication of microwave power transistors
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: An experimental evaluation is presented concerning the common-emitter parameters of silicon n-p-n transistors designed for a frequency band above 1 GHz. The configuration of the emitter and collector junctions essentially embodies a new concept whereby injection efficiency is increased by lateral injection. Exposure of P/sup +/ ions of Mo-n/sup +/Si ohmic contacts followed by annealing at low temperatures reduces the value of contact resistance, /spl rho//sub c/, and accelerates the recombination of minority carriers in the interface region.

articleTitle: Single frequency duplex repeater
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Practically all radio signal repeaters are based on frequency or time division. A single-frequency repeater based on noncrossing patterns of receiving and transmitting antennas is known. But practically such repeaters are not used due to the possibility of self oscillation or loss of sensitivity when the transmitted signal reaches the front end of the repeater's receiver. The idea of a single-frequency duplex repeater is described. The repeater saves frequency and time domain resources.

articleTitle: Symmetric passive components for ICs in LTCC technology
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The design of a symmetric spiral square inductor, 1:1 transformer, and symmetric balun have been described. Also, the main performance characteristics of the symmetric spiral square inductor have been considered.

articleTitle: Synthesis of the chaotic and regular dynamic in microwave transistor system
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A method to create dynamic models of microwave transistor systems is described. In systems with inertia, exhibiting regular and complicated dynamics, evolution of the auto-oscillation process depends both on the connection of inertial chain and on the type of dynamic characteristics of the nonlinear amplification element. These systems may be used in dynamic models of microwave transistor systems, which are inertial and consist of nonlinearities. The analysis shows that a global chaotization of oscillations in the system studied is preceded by a sequence of bifurcations according to the natural scale law, whereby zones of stable motion alternate with zones of chaotic motion.

articleTitle: Resonant dielectric antennas
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The problem of scattering electromagnetic waves from a radiating aperture by a system of high-Q dielectric resonators (DR) in free space is considered. General expressions are presented for calculating both the amplitudes of coupled oscillations and also the scattered field in the wave zone of the resonator system. The model developed gives analytical expressions for the wave zone field radiated by the system of coupled dielectric resonators. The expressions obtained are convenient for developing computing facilities for modelling the resonant dielectric antennas for the microwave and millimetre wave frequency bands.

articleTitle: MMIC GaAs MESFET switch
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: MESFET based switching devices have considerable initial losses and smaller valid switched microwave frequency power compared with p-i-n based circuits. MESFET switches possess lower current drainage and technological possibility of integration into the chip. Presented in this paper are the results of the design of GaAs MMIC with DPDT structure based on MESFET.

articleTitle: Microwave switch parameters synthesis by impedance transformation method with branching discontinuity effect compensation
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The elements used in a microwave switch include a variety of devices. Therefore, a synthesis method without limitation on switch parameters and which takes into account discontinuity effects is necessary. The paper proposes a method to synthesize the electrical parameters of single pole multi-throw (SPMT) switch. The method provides input matching and takes into account the branching discontinuity effect.

articleTitle: New manufacturing technology for InP epitaxial layers and properties of Schottky diodes made on their basis
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A new technological approach to production of structurally perfect epitaxial films LPE-grown on "soft" porous n/sup +/-InP substrates is considered. We studied surface morphology, boundary between phases in TiB/sub x/-n-InP contact and I-V curves of Au-TiB/sub x/-n-InP Schottky diodes made on "soft" and "rigid" (standard) n/sup +/-InP substrates. The advantages of epitaxial layers grown on porous n/sup +/-InP substrates and barrier structures on their basis are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Applicatory aerial for microwave radiometry
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: We show an opportunity for using a wave conductor for creation of a small-sized applicatory aerial for the measurement of human body temperature. The accounts of aerial parameters are carried out on the basis of oscillatory equations.

articleTitle: Microwave method for measurement of metal films on semiconductor substrates
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Theoretical end experimental investigations of the interaction of microwave radiation with metal-semiconductor structures have been carried out. The microwave method for measurement of thickness of metal films on semiconductor substrates, which allows monitoring the parameters of metal layers in the thickness range from 5 to 200 nm, is developed and realized.

articleTitle: Dielectric resonator with inhomogeneity - simulation method
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A method of computations for temperature stable resonant systems based on the use of constituent dielectric resonator (CDR) dielectric inclusions is proposed. System design and the method of computation are discussed.

articleTitle: SAW resonator filters for communications systems
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The results of research on designs of low-loss resonator SAW filters, intended for usage in input cascades of different communications systems are presented. The filters for a wide spectrum of passbands from 0.5 to 10% are practically realized.

articleTitle: Low noise hybrid-monolithic amplifier with PHEMT transistors
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The paper presents the results of the development and manufacture of an X-band super miniature low noise amplifier. The amplifier design and manufacturing technology are considered. Measured microwave parameters are shown.

articleTitle: Optimized microstrip filter with varactor-controlled tuning
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A band-pass filter on the basis of irregular microstrip varactor-tuned resonators is studied. The amplitude of the tuning rises with growth of the impedance step between microstrip lines forming the resonator. Maximum of tuning takes place when the ratio of low-impedance part length to high-impedance part length reaches 1/2. Ability is demonstrated to design a filter with a constant absolute bandwidth on filter tuning.

articleTitle: Electroforming assembly - new technology for manufacturing components and units of communication and navigation systems
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A set of millimeter-wave components and devices made by multilayer electroforming is presented. It is shown that the proposed technology makes possible quasi-monolithic multifunctional devices for communication facilities. The basic requirements for the microwave system of spaceborne equipment both for research and satellite communication are small mass and size, low cost and high reliability. Our technology based on multilayer electroforming in combination with electroforming assembly which has repeatedly proved its efficiency makes possible large-scale integration of multifunctional microwave devices. Its distinctive feature is a special electro-depositing regime that provides a fine-grain structure and high plasticity of the metals, and reusable knock-down matrices provide not only high manufacturing accuracy, but also the identity of the electrical parameters of the devices being manufactured. Besides, electroforming assembly makes possible monolithic multifunctional modules without any butt joints, the waveguide wall thickness being only 200 to 300 /spl mu/m as opposed to several millimeters in conventional structures thus offering far smaller mass and size of the device as a whole.

articleTitle: Small-sized dipole antenna arrays above the grid reflector
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Dipole antenna arrays with all-around azimuth looking are used in communication, radar and radio navigation systems. The perspective of further decrease in their sizes and mass is connected with insertion of the inductive impedance elements in the radiating branches of vibrators and realization of reflectors as grid structures. The results of analysis of the small-sized axisymmetrical radial and azimuthal dipole antenna arrays installed above the grid reflector are presented.

articleTitle: Multifunctional measuring device for CTV
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The LFM-400 device was presented at the previous conference. As a modification, the LFM-500 has had an optical power meter added and there is an opportunity to set up a telemetry connection between the devices. The optical power meter range is from -30 to +30 dBm. The opportunity presented by the telemetry connection allowed the use of the LFM-500 for cable net return path adjustment. The modernization of the LFM-400 widened the device functional possibilities. It released enough additional space on the front panel to include one more LCD monitor (full-color) for TV program visual control.

articleTitle: 8-mm wavelength synthesized sweep generator
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: This work describes a high-stability synthesised sweep generator in the frequency range of 25.86-37.5 GHz. The synthesiser functioning principles and the experimental results are presented.

articleTitle: A series of tunable microwave phase low noise oscillators
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A series of tunable microwave low phase noise oscillators is reviewed. We demonstrate the basic performances of the oscillators and their circuitry solutions. The designed series bridges the frequency band from 100 MHz to 5 GHz by oscillators with a tunable band from 20% to 150% and having a phase noise no more -90 dBc/spl bsol/Hz at 10 kHz frequency. Three designs, covering the frequency ranges 110-1210 MHz, 1200-3900 MHz and 3800-5000 MHz, respectively, are introduced.

articleTitle: Multi-frequency probing signal application for microwave imaging
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Experimental results of a multi-frequency probing signal application for microwave imaging radial resolution improvement are presented. Azimuth resolution of radio-holographic microwave imaging systems is determined by probing signal frequency, aperture dimensions and the signal synthesis method. Radial resolution is much lower than azimuth resolution. If the investigated objects are situated in the Fresnel region, it is practically impossible to obtain separate images of objects which are at different distances from the aperture. To improve radial resolution, wideband probing signals can be used. The paper presents a description of the radio-holographic microwave imaging system. Experimental results show that the multi-frequency probing signal application allows the radial resolution of microwave imaging systems to be improved. Three-dimensional microwave image construction based on reconstructed slices becomes possible. Moreover, the use of wideband probing signals improves image quality because of the noise level decrease.

articleTitle: Microstrip and slotline two-pole microwave filters with additional transmission zeros
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The work presents microstrip and slotline two-pole filters, which exhibit two finite symmetrical transmission zeros. To obtain extra transmission zeros, a source-load coupling is used in both cases. The microstrip filter has a center frequency of 3.3 GHz and a fractional bandwidth of 6%. The measured insertion loss is less than 0.35 dB. A bandstop filter is used for improving the rejection performance of the microstrip filter. The simulated performance of the slotline filter is also presented.

articleTitle: Small-base location system for narrowband SW-sources
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The paper proposes a new technique for measuring parameters of narrowband shortwave signals in the over-the-horizon propagation environment. Issues of small-base diversity-reception antenna design and digital processing of multimode signals are discussed. The designed system of shortwave reception allows for the potential of diversity reception to be retained, at the same time employing spectral-polarizing techniques. The implementation of modern digital signal processing systems offers increased reliability, parameter stability and accuracy in multichannel reception systems. The developed algorithms of signal processing and the designed antenna system allow for a more reliable mode separation and determination of angles of arrival for multimode narrowband tilt ionospheric sounding signals.

articleTitle: Measurement of vibration parameters of steam turbines blades using microwave approach
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The antenna parameter modeling results for an antenna located close to the steam turbine working blade wheel are discussed. The frequency pulling phenomenon of the UHF oscillator, working in conjunction with this antenna, is analysed.

articleTitle: Temperature-dielectric spectroscopy of solutions using the method of capillary-waveguide resonance
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Temperature dependence of the characteristics of a capillary-waveguide resonance is studied for greatly absorbing media. The possibility of using the suggested method for measurement of frequency dependence is surveyed. Temperature influence on frequency, and Q-factor and electromagnetic field energy absorption is researched at the resonance.

articleTitle: W-range compact multibeam TWT
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The project of a compact multibeam W-range TWT is presented. The main advantages of the multibeam TWT design are discussed.

articleTitle: Investigation of the causes of catastrophic degradation of silicon MOS-transistor parameters
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The paper aims to discover the causes of the catastrophic degradation of the parameters of silicon MOS-transistors formed by ordinary planar technology. The basic causes of degradation are as follows: (1) thermal compression contact rupture, which can be explained by the formation of intermetallic compounds in the contact area, resulting in brittleness of the contacts; (2) failure of metallic interconnections and contact pad integrity, resulting from not observing the photolithography technological conditions as well as from the presence of a developed defect structure on the silicon surface and the formation of silicide compounds.

articleTitle: Operating on chaotic fluctuations of klystron oscillators by external force
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: An experimental study is presented of the complex dynamics of a multi-cavity klystron self-oscillator with delay feedback under external periodic influence. It is shown that the addition of an external harmonic signal into the multi-cavity klystron self-sustained oscillator with delay feedback influences essentially on the system dynamics and helps to operate on the oscillation characteristics.

articleTitle: Calculation of non-uniform planar line transfer matrix
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The present paper concerns a way to calculate a non-uniform planar line (NPL) transfer matrix at which width the strip changes under any law along the length under condition of distribution to line quasi-T waves within the quasistatic approach. The method allows us to take into account the increase of NPL regional capacity at change of width of a planar element. Settlement expressions are characterized with simplicity of programming; they provide accuracy comprehensible for practical calculations and computer calculation is 3 times less in comparison with methods of final elements.

articleTitle: Wideband TWTA gain corrector
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: An effective use of over-octave band TWTA is not possible without special gain correctors providing for a maximum signal passage at the high and low edges of the TWTA's passband and the necessary fading (the depth of correction) closer to the medium frequency of the working range. We present the results of the development and investigation into the construction of a simple microstrip gain corrector on the basis of irregular half-wave resonators. In the 6-18 GHz band, the corrector provides for the depth of correction 15 dB with a VSWR not greater than 1.6. We have also shown the possibilities for realizing analogous schemes of correction with the overlap of frequencies from 2:1 to 5:1. The corrector is produced in the form of a thin film alumina plate of 7/spl times/6/spl times/0.25 mm size.

articleTitle: Extremely-high frequency band phased array antenna tuning method
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The flat reflector type phased antenna array (PAA) of extremely-high frequency band with waveguide ferrite phase shifters is investigated. The design-experiment method of tuning, gain factor optimization, beam track angle correction in the scanning sector and the sidelobe level reduction of the PAA are designed.

articleTitle: Design of the sectioned microstrip antennas
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The results of analysis of sectioned microstrip antennas are presented. In comparison with classical patch antennas they have smaller size, but are complex to design. The technique of design-experiment construction of such antennas is offered.

articleTitle: Choice of multistation protocol access in the small corporate satellite communication network
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A review of multistation access for the System of Operative Monitoring (a small corporate satellite communication network) is carried out. The direction of further research for the organization of SOM is chosen. Protocols of multistation access for small corporate satellite systems are considered.

articleTitle: Q-factor measurement of roll-wave resonator
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A method of cavity resonator Q-factor measurement, based on using an amplitude-modulated microwave signal with tunable modulation frequency, was examined. The ratio connecting the resonator Q-factor with resonant frequency and size of reconstruction frequencies tuning band is analysed.

articleTitle: The Ka-band VCO with linear tuning
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A Ka-band varactor tuned VCO is considered. It consists of a FET master oscillator and a driver amplifier intended for power gain and isolation of the master oscillator and the load. The linear tuning is due to a GaAs hyperabrupt junction varactor diode from the "Skywork" company. The tuning band is more than 1.5 GHz (from 35.5 to 37.2 GHz). Variation of tuning sensitivity is about 50%.

articleTitle: Tuneable piezoelectric filter based on a dual-mode dielectric resonator
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A frequency tuneable microwave filter based on a dual mode dielectric resonator is presented. Tuning of the filter is realised by using a piezoelectric bimorph. The main parameters of the filter are: central frequency in the middle of the range of tuning, 2.35 GHz; bandwidth for 1 dB level, /spl sim/0.5%; tuning range, /spl sim/10%. The insertion losses in the whole tuning range are below /spl sim/1 dB.

articleTitle: Simulation of MM-radiowave scattering over statistically uneven surfaces
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The work presents the results of numerically simulating the problem of EM MM-wave scattering over statistically uneven surfaces of natural and anthropogenic origin with regard to directional pattern. Calculations have been made using the perturbation technique and the tangential planes technique. The influence of wavelength, elevation of radiation source above the Earth's surface, angle of sight, electrophysical and statistical surface properties on scattered fields has been studied. The available mathematical and software tools allow for the scattered field and the absolute cross-section to be calculated for varied geometrical and electrophysical parameters of the problem. These investigations have been carried out with the aim of simulating a MM-wave radar radio channel. We intend to develop the model to encompass compound pulse probing signals and actual directional patterns.

articleTitle: Control system for large-scale multiservice wide-band networks of common access
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: We present an advanced system, which controls the whole structure of microwave integrated TV, radio and information system MITRIS-INT and its components. The system carries out rate compilation of MITRIS-INT subscribers using unique methods.

articleTitle: Millimeter-wave range resonators utilizing barium ferrite with domain structure
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Ferrite resonators are rather commonly used in tuneable filters and oscillators in the microwave range. The characteristics of millimeter-wave range resonators made of thin platelets of barium ferrite with bubble and stripe domains are considered.

articleTitle: Particularities of magnetic-resonance radiospectroscopy at automatic control of microwave frequency
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: This article presents the simulation results of sample resonant systems and measured cell interaction at EPR spectra registration by microwave oscillator automatic frequency control.

articleTitle: Coherent light scattering on plane gratings of silver nanoparticles
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A model is proposed to describe resonance effects, which take place when light is scattered on plane single-layer structures of silver nanoparticles in the framework of the dipole approximation.

articleTitle: Optimizing the H/sub 01/-to-H/sub 02/ mode transformer profile using the T-functions apparatus
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The most efficient procedure for calculating irregular waveguides, both in terms of computing and physical interpretation, is a technique based on mapping a randomly irregular interior of a waveguide onto a regular cylinder, a coax, etc., having a circular or rectangular cross-section. Handling this problem by traditional techniques does not involve any difficulties if only propagating waves are considered. However, for beyond-cutoff modes, the numerical solution of a boundary two-point problem using step-by-step techniques is impossible due to their fast divergence. In this case, special discretely determined T-functions (Kurayev, A.A. et al., 2003) should be applied. On the basis of the T-functions mechanism, a technique has been developed and the profile of an H/sub 01/-to-H/sub 02/ mode transformer has been calculated and optimized.

articleTitle: Fractal dimension of semiconducting fractal sensors
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Metal oxides are used for analysis of gas in the air in nano-dispersion semiconducting sensors developed in recent years. The fractal dimension of such a semiconductor sufficiently influences the character of the electrical conductivity and hence the sensitivity and operating speed of the sensor. The work considers the fractal properties of the structure of the sensitive weight of a semiconductor sensitive element (SE) for the detection of dangerous gas molecules. The way of defining the fractal dimension of the sensitive weight is shown by means of resistance measurement at high frequencies.

articleTitle: Miniature hermetically sealed coaxial to microstrip line launchers with coaxial line measuring 3.5/1.52 mm
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: We designed miniature hermetically sealed coaxial to microstrip line launchers (CMSL) with coaxial line measuring 3.5/1.52 mm and 50 ohm characteristic impedance. CMSL are designed for use at operating frequencies of DC to 18 GHz (maximum 1.25 VSWR) and DC to 36 GHz (maximum 1.4 VSWR). The construction and main parameters of CMSL are given in figures and in a table.

articleTitle: Characteristics of pulsed Vivaldi antenna
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Experimental and theoretical results of investigation of the Vivaldi antenna in the pulsed mode of operation are presented. Antenna power directive gain and efficiency of feeder system are calculated as a function of Gaussian pulse duration exciting the system. Experimental results on registration of received pulse time dependences in the communication channel consisting of two identical antennas are shown.

articleTitle: Horn antennas for 2.4 GHz radio networks
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The results of design of horn antennas with inhomogeneous waveguide as excitation device are considered. The experimental characteristics of the antenna radiation are shown and the results of horn antenna matching for 2.4 GHz radio networks are reported.

articleTitle: Application of SAW-filters in the ethereal television systems in the city conditions
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The results of investigation and practical application of "low-loss" filters based on surface acoustic waves (SAW) in ethereal collective television systems in city conditions are given. Use of the circuit of channel amplifiers in which frequency selectivity is carried out by the high-frequency SAW-filters included on the input and output of the amplifier is analysed.

articleTitle: Source of overbroadband noise oscillations to diagnostics of electronic devices
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Sources of broadband or overbroadband noise oscillations are required for diagnostics of various electronic devices. We propose that use of deterministic chaos is a perspective way to generate these sources. Signals are generated on a mixer from two autooscillators. One generator has a fixed frequency of generation. The second is frequency-modulated by a signal from a low-frequency chaotic source in a specified interval. The mixer output possesses a signal covering the frequency range from zero to several GHz.

articleTitle: BER performance of phase demodulator using a system of coupled oscillators
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Theoretical and experimental investigation is carried out concerning the added noise influence on a system of coupled oscillators synchronized with a phase-split external signal. By its BER performance, the phase demodulator using said system is shown to be asymptotically equivalent to the optimum coherent demodulator.

articleTitle: Increase of measurement accuracy of frequency mistunings of resonant sensors [dielectric materials measurement applications]
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: This work presents the structure of a microwave resonant sensor frequency mistuning meter. This structure provides an increase of the measurement accuracy. The effects of the measurement path units instability and the quality of the resonator interaction with the researched material are considered.

articleTitle: Optically controlled active generator for superhigh frequencies
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Investigations are presented of an SHF active generator based on HEMT type transistors, which have shown the possibility of both optical and electric control of the oscillation frequency.

articleTitle: Universal multimedia distributive system
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Presented in This work is new universal multimedia distributive system (UMDS) which belongs to the fixed systems of broadband wireless access, unites the basic advantages of known systems MITRIS and MTRS, has open interfaces and legal levels and agrees with standard IEEE 802.16.

articleTitle: Microstrip filter based on multi-mode resonators
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A microstrip filter based on three hairpin resonators having irregular stubs was developed. The use of multi-mode resonators gives the opportunity of obtaining highly selective properties in a device with a fractional pass-band of less than 5%.

articleTitle: The inverse problem of reconstructing real dielectric permittivity with discontinuous profile
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: An important inverse problem in electrodynamics is the determination of the permittivity of a nonhomogeneous medium. An exact algorithm of permittivity reconstruction by the frequency dependence of the amplitude reflection index is given, based on the extended Balanis integral equation.

articleTitle: Acoustic-electronic cryotron of high velocity
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: An acoustic-electronic cryotron of high velocity based upon YBa/sub 2/Cu/sub 3/O/sub 7/ superconductor operated by acoustic surface wave (ASW) provides for automatic switchover time period with a fixed step contemporaneously in two opposite directions: clockwise in sections I and III, and counterclockwise in sections II and IV. The ratio of switchover time period step in a cryotron operated by ASW depends on the number of contacts, ASW frequency and contact distribution configuration. Results of a high velocity acoustic-electronic cryotron development with automatic switchover time period are presented.

articleTitle: Effects of EM-radiation activated water on biological objects
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The aim of the investigation was to study the influence of EHF-field activated mains water (pH 6.2) and phosphate buffer (pH 7.0) with additional 2.89 mM calcium chloride on buccal epithelium cells and wheat seeds. Another important task was to compare this influence and response with those of the cells and seeds irradiated directly.

articleTitle: Silicon MIS-varactors with the double layer dielectric films from rare-earth oxides
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Electrical and physical properties of Al-Dy/sub 2/O/sub 3/-Gd/sub 2/O/sub 3/-Si MIS-structures have been investigated. Values of surface states density on the semiconductor-dielectric interface, values of surface generation velocity and the lifetime of minority charge carriers were determined.

articleTitle: Theoretical analysis of the planar dielectric resonator
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Cylindrical surface waves along a thin dielectric with high dielectric permeability is considered. The received dispersion equations allow us to determine the existence conditions of cylindrical waves. A theoretical analysis of the planar dielectric resonator is made.

articleTitle: The antenna with switchable far-field patterns for mobile communication systems
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The results of theoretical and experimental investigations of an oscillator antenna within 900 MHz frequency band are considered. The antenna consists of three alternatively active arms installed circumferentially on the cylindrical screen face. Switching is provided by a pin-diode circuit. Two passive arms operate as reflectors for the active one. As a result one of three possible far-field patterns is formed with beamwidth 120/spl deg/.

articleTitle: Three-channel digital transceiver of short waves band
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: One of the possible ways to increase the reception capacity of a communication channel and noise proof factor is the use of a modern digital element base, which allows us to realize the direct synthesis and reception of the radio signal. The structure, technical features and application of the 3-channel digital transceiver SQ range, in the Hi Tech Company "Tenzor" and NPP "Polyot", is considered.

articleTitle: Oscillator mode for the investigation of dielectric properties of liquids
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: This work presents the design of a of mm wave dielectrometer measuring cell, which allows the classification of a broad class of fluids, including those having a high value of loss tangent. The influence of a broad class of liquids on the Gunn diode generation characteristics of a dielectric semidisk oscillator is investigated.

articleTitle: Adaptation of MATLAB CDMA model for analyzing of multiuser detector in WCDMA system
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: We presented our investigations of the adopted existing CDMA models in MATLAB 6.5 for the third generation mobile communications system (WCDMA). The existing CDMA libraries of the package were analyzed and the second generation CDMA model was adapted to meet the necessary requirements of the WCDMA system for analyzing a multiuser detector.

articleTitle: The antenna measurement methods of the radiation power of the industrial radio interferences using the spectrum analyzer of 0.01 - 178.4 GHz
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: This work describes the basic stages of antenna methods for measurement of industrial radio interference radiated power, using the developed spectrum analyzer. This is intended for research into the harmonic radio signal spectrum in the frequency range of 0.01-178.4 GHz, covered by 8 external mixers in 13 sub-bands.

articleTitle: The oscillator with electronic tuning of frequency of a MM-band using discrete elements
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The construction of a Gunn diode oscillator with electronic tuning of the operating frequency using discrete elements is offered. The oscillator operates in a millimeter-wavelength band.

articleTitle: Reliability of transfer of the information in Ethernet radio networks with spasmodic change of frequency
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A mathematical model for a quantitative rating of information transfer reliability in Ethernet radio networks with spasmodic change of frequency is presented. It takes into account both interference from external sources and intersystem interference.

articleTitle: Comparison of microwave integrated phase shifters by means of merit figure
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Comparative analysis performed by means of the merit figure of about 80 electronically controllable microwave integrated phase shifters, which had been recently reported in the literature, is presented. Results of the analysis allowed a conclusion to be made about the efficiency of using different controlling devices to design phase shifters with higher figure of merit.

articleTitle: Experimental research into frequency tuning of a 3 mm orotron with a weakly relativistic electron stream
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: An experimental study of orotron tuning over a 78-100 GHz frequency range has been carried out for two values of spherical mirror radii and three values of interaction space heights. A two-row periodic structure (PS) has been used and the comparison of experimental results with previous theoretical calculations has been made.

articleTitle: The study of chaotic synchronization of two coupled active electron-wave media with cubic nonlinearity
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Chaotic phase synchronization of oscillations in two coupled electron-wave systems with a backward wave and cubic phase nonlinearity (backward wave tube, BWT, with a transverse field) has been studied. A new approach to the analysis of chaotic phase synchronization of distributed systems by means of a wavelet transform has been proposed. The physical processes which are responsible for the transition from asynchronous oscillations to the phase synchronization regime have also been considered.

articleTitle: Possible applications of periodic metal-dielectric structures in EHF electronics
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Various types of radiation effects generated by electrons moving along periodic heterogeneities have found wide applications in EHF electronics. Results of investigating resonant open electrodynamic systems with metal-dielectric structures (MDS) are presented. The obtained data may be used in the design of new versions of EHF amplifier and oscillator devices.

articleTitle: New possibilities of functional and technical design in full-cycle microwave stripline CAD system
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: In this article, we considered some new features of an interactive program for the stripline CAD system. This system is only one from four parts of integrated system "LAMBDA+". The stripline CAD system allows design of circuits, based on different types of microstrip lines and their combinations.

articleTitle: Retrieval of scanning Auger microscopy images
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The development of micro- and nanoelectronics needs chemical diagnostics of structures with nanometre resolution. The progress in scanning probe microscopy, in particular, in the method of scanning Auger microscopy (SAM) (S.T. Purcell et al, Nanotechnology, vol. 12, pp. 168-172, 2001; F.A. Stevie et al, J. Vac. Sci. Technol. B, vol. 17, no. 6, pp. 2476-2482, 1999), could solve this problem. The depth resolution of this method achieves by now a sub-nanometer barrier (S. Hofmann, Rep. Prog. Phys., vol. 61, pp. 827-888, 1998), but the lateral resolution amounts to no better than tens of nanometers. The goal of this work is to improve the lateral resolution of SAM by image processing using Tikhonov's method of deconvolution that takes into account the probe transfer function.

articleTitle: Design of the ultrawideband 0.85-17.44 GHz test antenna
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The results of the design of a measuring antenna for the 0.85 to 17.44 GHz frequency band are presented. Antenna gain was measured to be at least 9 dB at 0.85 GHz and 28 dB at 17.44 GHz. The antenna is intended to generate the reference electromagnetic field during measurements with an appropriate signal source, and, together with appropriate receivers, for electromagnetic field analysis, for electromagnetic environment monitoring, and for measurements of antenna parameters and small levels of electromagnetic power. The antenna type is named the P6-23M. It is a horn-coaxial antenna, which is a conventional horn combined with a complex wideband waveguide-coaxial junction. The antenna port is a standard coax with 50 ohm impedance which is gradually converted into the link, with the off-center internal rod connected with a ridged waveguide which is in turn gradually converted into the H waveguide horn. The wide frequency band, high technical performance and the possibility of operation in the harsh climatic environment of -50/spl deg/C to + 50/spl deg/C nominate this antenna as the best one in the corresponding class of antennas.

articleTitle: The peculiarities of aperture field distribution of reflector antenna with arbitrary positioned irradiator
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The analysis results are presented of the aperture field distribution in a reflector antenna with the phase center of the irradiator arbitrarily positioned. Calculation and analysis of the antenna far-field radiation pattern and directive gain for an antenna with a multibeam (scanning) mode of radiation are performed. The possibility of scan sector broadening by optimal choice of the irradiator position is shown.

articleTitle: Millitron - a generator of low-intensity polychromatic naturally-polarized radiation
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The paper describes a mm-wave generator in which a low-intensity polychromatic signal is polarized by a plate made of bone tissue. The generator design and operation are discussed.

articleTitle: The ways of improving radiosystems with automatic adaptation to noise influence
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: We investigate present types of automatic adaptation to noise influence and we design a receiver structure which allows the realizing of a new method of adaptation by sensitivity.

articleTitle: Directional coupler for wideband small-size microwave transducer
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A wideband two-gap directional coupler, which may be used in small-sized transducers for waveguide device microwave parameter meters, is considered.

articleTitle: Frequency stabilization of MM-wave solid-state oscillators. Resonant systems
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The essential feature required by oscillator systems for the frequency stabilization of solid-state sources in the short-wave part of the MM-wave band is formulated. A small-size quasi-optical corner-echelette open resonator (OR) is proposed for this purpose. The 2D model analysis method is described and results of an experimental study of the features of the OR are presented. It is recommended that these ORs be used in oscillators in the 50-150 GHz frequency band.

articleTitle: Compact active Doppler calibrator
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Radar reflectors-calibrators are used for external calibration of radar sets and moving target imitation. In this paper, a compact active Doppler calibrator, and features of its development and application, are discussed. The presented active Doppler calibrator can be applied to the calibration of different meter and decameter range radars.

articleTitle: Spectral property studies of disc quasi-optical dielectric resonator with a liquid-filled capillary
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Results of experimental study and theoretical analysis of spectral characteristics of "whispering gallery" HE mode waves are presented for a disc quasi-optical dielectric resonator (QDR) with liquid-filled capillary as a heterogeneity. The character of QDR eigenfrequency dependence with different liquids is different with capillary diameter change. The mentioned feature similarity for water and metal are characterized by opposite signs of the frequency shift depending on wave mode, either HE or EH.

articleTitle: Optimizing relativistic TWT-Os built around irregular waveguides with regard to higher modes
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Results of developing a nonlinear theory of relativistic TWTs and BWT-Os built around irregular hollow waveguides with regard to both propagating and beyond-cutoff waves are given. Robust computational procedures with allowance made for beyond-cutoff waves are covered in great detail. The results are given of optimizing various relativistic TWT-Os by efficiency.

articleTitle: Development and study of absorbers of electromagnetic waves
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Electrodynamic methods of analyzing the parameters of broadband electromagnetic wave absorbers are considered. The results of physical and computing experiments for the development of electromagnetic wave absorbers for anechoic chamber equipment are presented.

articleTitle: Thermostable helicon isolator
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The temperature responses of forward loss and backward attenuation of broadband helicon isolator are investigated using a schematic model. Experimental results confirm the model adequacy.

articleTitle: Impedance autotransformers based on canonical nonuniform transmission lines
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Impedance autotransformers based on canonical nonuniform transmission lines are considered. Their advantages over autotransformers based on uniform transmission lines (UTL) in overall dimensions/broadbandness are shown.

articleTitle: Directive gain of corner antenna arrays
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Questions of the directive gain calculation for radiating systems in terms of full and partial far-field patterns are considered in the paper pertaining to corner antenna arrays as an example.

articleTitle: Antennas line for high-precision omnidirectionally scanning radars
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: In antennas with series feed most commonly used in all-looking radars, the decrease of antenna length results in a widening of the radiation pulse. Millimeter-wave antennas assigned for high-precision all-around looking radars in ship, coast and airfield applications are described.

articleTitle: Synthesis of test signals in extended wide frequency range [EM field immunity applications]
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: To automatically test the technical means of immunity to RF electromagnetic field effects, it is reasonable to use special generator equipment (test signal generators, TSG) that allow the generation of standard test signals in a frequency range from 20 Hz to 2000 MHz. This paper presents an outline of such equipment.

articleTitle: Software system for analysis of electromagnetic compatibility between fixed service equipment and DCS-1800 base equipment with grouped frequency application
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The functioning of the mobile cellular communications network DCS-1800 with application of the mode of frequency channel grouped utilization permits us to increase effectiveness of both use of assigned frequencies and system interference immunity. The capabilities of a software system designed for electromagnetic compatibility assessment, its application and ways of development are described.

articleTitle: A series of microwave synthesizers
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A series of microwave synthesizers intended for use in different types of electronic equipment is designed. The series of extra-small, broadband, frequency synthesizers is intended to operate in the temperature range -40 to +60/spl deg/C with relative frequency instability of /spl plusmn/2.5/spl times/10/sup 6/. The structurally designed synthesizers are executed in universal two-level bodies with dimensions 100/spl times/70/spl times/25 mm and are functionally-complete devices.

articleTitle: Optimization of radiometric circuitry in developing high-precision polarimeters and fast-response spectrum analyzers
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The paper suggests new circuitry solutions which offer an increased brightness-temperature and frequency resolution in radiometric devices. The issues of microwave identification of cloud phase composition require the development of polarimeters - polarization radiometers - with simultaneous real-time measurement of vertical, horizontal, and difference polarizations. The main requirements imposed on such devices include high sensitivity, stability, wide dynamic range, noise immunity, and optional self-contained power supply. The task of spectrally monitoring solar activity in the microwave range calls for spectrometers with very small values of integrating constant. The proposed engineering solutions allow the polarimeter sensitivity to reach 0.05 K, which is approximately 3-4 times higher than with previously available polarimeters. The designed heliospectrograph offers a 4-times faster response. The implemented technique of asymmetrically separating the modulation signal offers a 17% increase in sensitivity compared to 'classical' techniques.

articleTitle: Telecommunication protocols and technologies, used in MITRIS-INT system
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: We consider the technologies used in the MITRIS-INT system, providing user access to communication and information services. We present the main telecommunication protocols and technologies used in the system. These protocols specify the system operation at different hierarchy levels, thus providing access to telecommunication and information services.

articleTitle: Conical and biconical resonator-based transducers for vibration parameter measurement
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The resonance frequencies calculation results of a biconical and a conical resonator with a metal or dielectric rod are presented. It is shown that when the resonance frequency of the resonator is changed using metal rods, the rate of frequency change is 1.2 to 2 times higher than in the case of dielectric rods.

articleTitle: Theoretical comparison of photopolymer materials on the basis of record kinetics of diffraction gratings
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Comparison of two types of photopolymer materials is carried out based on the kinetics of recording transmission and reflection gratings by numerical simulation of diffraction efficiency. The simulation is based on two analytical models created earlier (Dovolnov, E. and Sharangovich, S., Proc. SPIE, vol.5104, p.116-127, 2003; Proc. SPIE, vol.5464, p.12, 2004).

articleTitle: Bandwidth optimization of power cluster cavity MBK
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The results of the bandwidth optimization of a cluster cavity klystron are presented. Multi-beam klystron cluster schemes permit the following klystron bandwidth parameters to be improved: bandwidth value, efficiency, frequency response uniformity.

articleTitle: Miniature hermetically sealed coaxial microwave interference filter designed by "ISTOK" company
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The designed miniature hermetically sealed coaxial microwave interference filters provide effective filtering of spurious signals in DC power lines and signal lines with 50...50 dB attenuation level. Cut off frequency for different types of filters is from 10 to 200 MHz. The construction and main parameters of the filters are given in figures and in a table.

articleTitle: A modified bow-tie antenna design for step-frequency subsurface radar applications
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A modified bow-tie antenna for step-frequency ground penetrating radar is proposed. The flared dipole arm consists of a metal sector gradually converting into a strip-slot structure loaded by resistive films. For the comparison, a TEM horn is used. The synthesized pulse waveform is computed from the frequency-domain data using a calibration procedure and inverse Fourier transform. The antenna performance is demonstrated in several examples of detecting small shallowly buried subsurface targets.

articleTitle: Sidelobes attenuation of cellular base station antenna due to application of metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: High efficiency of unwanted lateral radiation attenuation due to application of radio absorbers based on metamaterials is shown in the paper by the example of the cellular base station antenna AMPA065-18. More than 10 dB far sidelobe attenuation of the radiation far-field patterns is obtained for both co-polarization and cross-polarization. The additional suppression in power gain is found to be less than 0.5 dB due to application of radio absorbers.

articleTitle: Parameters of stand alone synchronization equipment for holdover regime
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: We consider the basic principles of operation of synchronization equipment for holdover mode. Frequency drift possibly compensates different methods of production of synchronization equipment.

articleTitle: Resonant method of the express estimation of bandwidth of active substance in the submillimeter laser
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A simple method of radiation bandwidth measurement of a submillimeter laser is presented. Additional measuring equipment is not required for this method. Measurements are carried out by means of the micrometric mechanism of the moving resonator mirror.

articleTitle: Videocontrol signals coding device
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
