abstract: Technical decisions in the coding of black-and-white pictures by means of analog video signal transformation into digital signal, transposition of line fragments and back transformation with the help of digital analog transformation have been considered.

articleTitle: Electrodynamic system with coupled ring-shaped resonators
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The work presents the results of experimental investigations in the millimeter wave band of an electrodynamic system that consists of two metallic blocks of coupled ring-shaped resonators. The automatic setup developed for investigating such systems was used in the experiments. As a result, graphical images of the spectral characteristics were obtained, and the Q-factor values were calculated for excited oscillation types.

articleTitle: MM-wave rain scattering with regard to raindrop nonsphericity
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Angle dependences of MM-wave rain scattering have been numerically analyzed using the T-matrix technique with regard to both the raindrop nonsphericity and size distribution. Results of numerically calculating the angle dependence of rain scattering are presented. The differential scattering cross-section of a single raindrop has been studied. Angle dependence of scattering cross-sections for unit volume of rain have been analyzed. The available results may prove useful in the design of frequency reuse systems.

articleTitle: Implementation of mobile broadband radioaccess systems on the base of MIMO technology
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: We present the new technology of spatial-temporal diversities of MIMO signals, which has potential for creation of mobile broadband radioaccess systems due to large information capacity and interference nonsusceptibility from multibeam propagation. The most prospective direction of further improvement of mobile telecommunications is implementation of high-speed broadband radioaccess systems (voice link, transmission of video and data) on this basis. However there is an actual problem in obtaining high transfer rates in radio systems for mobile service. The transfer rate of fixed wireless broadband access systems reaches tens of megabits per second, while using cellular networks of 3rd and 4th generations (3G, 4G) it is possible to reach transfer rates for the mobile user of no more than 2 Mbit/s. The major factor which impedes the increase of information transfer rate is multiray propagation in the radio channel between the mobile user and base station. In order to decide this problem, the so-called multi-antenna technology MIMO (multi input multi output) and a number of its modifications are used.

articleTitle: Transmission of submillimeter beams through oversized hollow waveguides
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Using the representation of an input field by way of the spectrum of propagating modes or ray tubes, modal and geometrical optics procedures for calculation of irradiative propagation in oversized hollow circular waveguides at their excitation by linearly polarized Gaussian beams are proposed. Conditions of optimum excitation are found and the polarization degree of output beams is determined at their waveguide transmission.

articleTitle: The irregular TWT on the bent rectangular waveguide
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The electrodynamic method of calculation of an irregular TWT on a bent rectangular waveguide is given. An estimation of the influence of higher modes on processes of electron beam and electromagnetic wave interaction is presented.

articleTitle: Passivation of the silicon semiconductor devices and microwave frequency attachments with the double layer dielectric films from yttrium oxide and dysprosium oxide
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The recombination properties of silicon passivated with double layer dielectric films of yttrium oxide and dysprosium oxide have been investigated. The values of effective lifetime and surface recombination velocity of the nonequilibrium charge carriers on the interface of the rare-earth elements/silicon-oxide have been defined.

articleTitle: Calculating the E/sub 01/-mode dispersion characteristics in a corrugated waveguide with various period shapes
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: On the basis of a rigorous theory, the dispersive characteristics of E/sub 0m/ waves in a hollow waveguide with various corrugation periods are investigated. Areas in parameters of the waveguide geometry have been found offering efficient interaction between an electron stream and a decelerated harmonic of the high-power Gerenkov generator wave field.

articleTitle: Own frequencies and factors of coupling in three-resonator microstrip section
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Calculated and experimental results of own frequencies as functions of coupling length of three microstrip resonators are compared. The calculations were carried out in a quasi-TEM approach. The discovered behavior of own frequencies agrees well with the results obtained for interacting contours with simultaneously inductive and capacitive coupling.

articleTitle: Planar dielectric disk antennas
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The results of experimental investigations of planar dielectric disk antennas with different substrates and radiating elements are presented. Geometric and electromagnetic parameters of antenna prototypes are selected in accordance with theoretical calculations. The use of substrates with different dielectric permittivity is determined to give rise to the change in the radiation pattern shape. The possibility is shown to increase radiation power in the free space and to broaden antenna bandwidth in comparison with similar metal disk antennas.

articleTitle: Measurements of dielectric losses in uniaxial and biaxial crystals
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The majority of high quality materials produced by industry are anisotropic crystals. So, for their certification it is important to know not only integral losses (average volume of whole dielectric material), but the dependence of the dielectric losses upon the detachment of the crystal directions (upon the main directions, for example). The electrodynamic and numerical Q-factor calculations of H- and E-modes of a rectangular waveguide junction, filled by tetragonal uniaxial crystals and rhombic biaxial crystals, have been carried out in this work. The methods of the anisotropic substrate dielectric losses for non-destructive measurements along the main directions of the crystal dielectric permittivity tensor have been created. The aim of this work is to calculate the Q-factor of H/sub 110/ and E/sub 110/ modes of a wave junction based on rectangular waveguides. During the calculation of the Q/sub 0//sup E,H/ the losses in the walls of the waveguides were taken into consideration, that form the junction (R/sub S/-surface waveguide walls resistance, R/sub Sm/-surface waveguide copper walls resistance) and dielectric losses /spl epsi/" (/spl epsi/=/spl epsi/'-i/spl epsi/") along the main directions of the crystal.

articleTitle: Optical assembly for CTV
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: We considered in this paper technical decisions and results of the optical assembly design (on the basis of a trunk amplifier). It is intended for signal receiving and transmitting in direct and return CATV channels of the optical range.

articleTitle: Study of adjustable irregular microstrip resonator [microwave measurement applications]
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: An adjustable irregular microstrip resonator (IMR) is considered in this work for measurement of the electromagnetic spectra parameters of materials. The possibility of length change of the resonator allows the performance of measurements at 10 frequency points in the 0.46-3.30 GHz range.

articleTitle: Generator of a MM-range series operation of GaAs Gunn-diodes
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: We experimentally investigated the operation of two Gunn-diodes in series; they are designed for operation in the 8 mm wavelength band. Experimental samples of diodes made in the semiconductor engineering problem laboratory of of the Kharkov National University were investigated. The experimental samples of GaAs Gunn-diodes operate in continuous mode and have the following parameters: threshold voltage of 2 V, threshold currents of 1.2-1.25 A, output microwave power of 60-80 mW. For each diode volt-ampere and volt-watt characteristics were run. The diodes were compared and selected under the optimum characteristics. The characteristics are presented for single diodes and for two series connected diodes. If the parameters of diodes are equal (threshold currents within 1-2% of each other), the included diodes consistently work simultaneously. The frequency of generation is synchronized by the higher frequency diode (in our experiment it made 37.54 GHz), and the total output microwave power with two diodes consistently made 120 mW (factor of addition of output power of single diodes about 0.9).

articleTitle: Single-loop synthesizer for C-band with ultra fine frequency step
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The work considers the results of a C-band simple frequency synthesizer design based on a single loop PLL. The Skyworks CX72302 fractional-N PLL IC was chosen for the exciter and LO design. A high-Q dielectric resonator oscillator (DRO) is used to obtain better noise performance out of the PLL passband. A linear frequency sweep is carried out using a varicap having weak coupling with the DR. The output power of DRO generator is 50 mW. The weak coupling between the varicap and dielectric resonator in the tuned generator provides rather good noise parameters, but the synthesized frequency band is too narrow (approximately 50 MHz within the varicap tuning range of 1-25 V). The single chip fractional-N PLL allows small size single-loop frequency synthesizers to be constructed for frequencies up to the maximum operating PLL IC frequency with the frequency step less than 400 Hz and acceptable phase noise level.

articleTitle: The microwave converter of radio impulses duration on base of the running wave resonator
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A converter construction method of the microwave radiation modulated by a meander in a sequence of coherent microwave impulses of nanosecond duration is considered. Results of the analysis of the transformation process are given.

articleTitle: Ground support for aerospace remote sensing of the Earth surface
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Ground support for remote sensing of the Earth's surface is a complicated problem which is sometimes approached without due regard given to the laws and requirements established by the fundamental nature of the remote sensing technique. To address this problem adequately means employing the latest data from numerous sciences, spanning almost everything between electrodynamics and agriculture. The paper summarizes the 15-year research experience accumulated by the authors.

articleTitle: Modern multiservice wireless network
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The main principles for the creation of modern telecommunication networks are considered. A version of multiservice wireless network is shown.

articleTitle: Thin film bulk wave acoustic resonators (FBAR) based filters
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The advantages, constructions, materials for production of FBAR are analyzed. Active schemes of filters based on FBAR are proposed, and the results of modeling of active piezoelectric filters are discussed.

articleTitle: Microwave component in emissions of light-therapy equipment
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: It has been proven experimentally that the spectrum of polarized polychromatic low-energy radiation with wavelengths of 480-3400 nm emitted by BIOPTRON devices contains a polarized microwave component. Its presence may be regarded as an opportunity for producing additional biological effects, including therapeutic ones.

articleTitle: Synthesis of active filters taking into account dissipative losses
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The calculation of the filters was carried out during two stages. There is determination of equivalent parameters in the first stage. The loaded attenuation of the filter extreme resonance circuit, natural attenuation of resonance circuits, negative attenuation of the loop containing an active element (for the active filters), and coefficients of connection between adjacent loops are determined for the given specifications (including admissible value of dissipative losses). The concrete aspect of the microwave filter is determined at the second stage under the requirements of design, technology or diverse character. The design dimensions are calculated (the width and the length of the strips, and the gap between the strips). It is possible to obtain the equivalent circuit of the active filter, a similar circuit of the element that brings negative attenuation by introduction of a passive filter.

articleTitle: Static characteristics of crossed quantum wires
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The electric characteristics of a device based on two crossed quantum wires are calculated. It was demonstrated that the different functionalities may be realized using such a device. The design of an energy converter based on quantum wires is offered.

articleTitle: Broad-band antenna for cellular communications
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A printed microstrip antenna in the range of 0.5-4 GHz for cellular communications is presented. The antenna can be designed for 50 /spl Omega/ or different impedance. Design and measured radiating parameters are also shown.

articleTitle: Analytical estimation of mutual coupling between antennas on complex three-dimensional construction
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The results of developing an analytical approach to estimating the mutual coupling coefficients between two antennas installed on complex three-dimensional construction are considered. The analytical approach used is based on a physical optics method which is always realized when the direct coupling between antennas through their far-field patterns is absent (when the line-of-sight coverage between antennas is overlapped with different obstacles).

articleTitle: The calculation of the maximum relative time interval error on a synchronization interfaces
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The maximum time interval error (MTIE) is one of the main time domain stability measures for the signals on a SDH transport network synchronization interface. A method for synchronization signal stability measurement on the primary reference clock (PRC) interface is considered.

articleTitle: Measurement of the dielectrics using the near-field microwave microscope
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A technique for measurement of the dielectric constant of materials is submitted. For this purpose, a near-field microwave microscope (NFMM) was used. A piece of coaxial wave guide was applied, with the internal conductor acting as a probe, and also a build-up of its possible mathematical model is discussed. The offered measurement technique allows significant simplification of the sample manufacturing requirements, concerning its size and form. Thus, the measurement error becomes a fraction of a percent when a standard circuit analyzer such as the P2-65 is used. By using the microwave frequency meter, measurement accuracy will increase. Besides, the use of the NFMM allows carrying out the control of a sample's uniformity with high resolution.

articleTitle: Semiconductor microwave oscillators controlled by the bias voltage
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A simple method for control of the output power of semiconductor microwave oscillators by changing the bias voltage of an active element when using a scheme with a synchronized oscillator is investigated. It is proved theoretically and realized experimentally that the output power of semiconductor microwave oscillators can be controlled by changing the bias voltage of an active element. A change of up to 40 dB of the oscillator output power has been achieved at a constant output frequency when the bias changes by 2.7%.

articleTitle: Generation wide-band chaotic oscillation
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The theoretical opportunity of creating chaotic generators is also investigated experimentally on the basis of two or more coupled one-transistor generators in the microwave range. The paper reports the design of transistor microwave oscillators in which it is possible to control the frequency band and the spectral characteristic is smooth. We show that the use of two and three coupled transistor auto-oscillators allows us to create microwave chaotic wide-band generators.

articleTitle: Results of design of radio Ethernet devices for 2400-2485, 5150-5350, 5725-5825 MHz
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The work considers technical decisions and characteristics used in Ethernet signal transmitting devices on the radiochannel in the 2400-2485 MHz frequency range and in the recently chosen ranges of 5150-5350 MHz and 5725-5825 MHz. The appearance of these additional ranges for radio Ethernet signal transmission makes easier the situation on the service market because of the possibility to select signals with the help of a narrower transmitting and receiving antenna directivity pattern. Using transmitters and transmitting converters in IBSS, BSS and ESS nets allows points to be connected at distances of 20 km and more.

articleTitle: The problems and paths of improvement in telecommunication specialists training
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The paper discusses the lack of correspondence in the training of telecommunications specialists to present-day requirements. New technologies for information exchange and means of realizing them are proposed.

articleTitle: Microwave resonance therapy in treating diabetes mellitus and its complications
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Microwave resonance therapy (MRT) used in the treatment of diabetes mellitus and its complications has been shown to provide positive clinical effects. Using the MRT has made it possible to achieve the following: to reduce the blood sugar level, improve blood supply in the lower extremities for angiopathy cases, improve the locomotor system fitness and the overall patients' condition. The MRT has been successfully used for treating diabetes mellitus of various types and severities irrespective of the state of carbohydrate metabolism compensation. Among the principal positive effects of the treatment are the relief of dysmetabolic syndrome and dysfunctions of vascular and other systems, which results in the overall improvement in the patients' life quality.

articleTitle: The isochronous DRO [diffraction radiation oscillator]
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Diffraction radiation oscillator (DRO) devices are built around a semi-spherical or spherical cylindrical open resonator (OR) with one of the mirrors carrying a diffraction grating. A packetized 33-37 GHz DRO using an isochronous grating has been developed. The offered output power is 40 W and the efficiency is /spl sim/8.76% at a voltage of 3.2 kV and electron current of 140 mA. The DRO weight, including the magnet system, is 5 kg.

articleTitle: HPM generation by use of resonant relativistic BWO driven by compact inductive energy storage
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The paper describes the installation and experimental results of high-power microwave generation by a resonant relativistic BWO (3.6 GHz, TM/sub 01/) (Kitsanov, S.A. et al., Proc. 14th Int. Conf. on High Power Particle Beams, p.255-8, 2002) driven by a high-voltage generator based on inductive storage (cable line) and an electro-explosive opening switch. As a primary source, either capacitive storage (surge current generator) or magnetic cumulative generator (MCG) was used. For a cathode voltage of 700 kV and diode current of 9 kA, the peak microwave power reached about 0.5 GW and pulse duration was about 50 ns.

articleTitle: Hybrid O-type frequency shifter with magnetic focusing field
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: One of the least investigated problems of the interaction between RF fields and streams of charged particles is frequency conversion in multidimensional nonlinear beam-wave systems. One aspect of this problem, the effect of the magnetic focusing field induction value on the output characteristics of the millimeter waves hybrid frequency multiplier, is investigated. The multidimensional simulation of beam-wave interaction in a hybrid frequency shifter is carried out, taking into account the change of the magnetic focusing field induction. The enhancement of the output power of higher harmonics of the input signal frequency is obtained for certain values of cyclotron frequency. The physical reasons for the detected effects are considered.

articleTitle: Test bed for electromagnetic compatibility tests on effect of ultra-short pulsed electromagnetics
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Design features of a test bed with an operational volume of 1 m/sup 3/ for ultra-short pulsed (USP) electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) tests of radio-electronic equipment (REE) are presented.

articleTitle: Fine analysis of emission structure of two-color semiconductor laser in near field zone
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The aim of this work is investigation of the spatial distribution of different modes of two-color semiconductor IR laser emission. The attractive property of this laser is the possibility of generation of terahertz oscillation with the help of mixing of two different modes of laser radiation. For successful realization of this problem, the spatial matching of these modes is necessary. We have achieved a higher resolution that makes it possible to observe radiation map details with sizes of about 50 nanometers. The scanning near-field optical microscope (SNOM) resolution is determined by the size of the probe aperture (/spl sim/50-100 nm), which is much smaller than the wavelength of light. To obtain better resolution, measurement results have been processed further, taking into account the probe transfer function.

articleTitle: The coaxial collinear antenna with series slot feeding scheme
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The results are presented of a theoretical investigation of a coaxial collinear antenna with a one-stage, but many element, series feeding divider. This is achieved by the use of slots, located 2 wavelengths apart from each other, in the outer conductor of the coaxial feed line.

articleTitle: Observation, properties and applications of microwave radiation negative fluxes
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Results of experiments in observing and medically applying mm-wave negative fluxes are presented suggesting their high therapeutic efficiency. Negative fluxes enable investigations into the properties of a biological object eliminating the need for its additional irradiation and using only its intrinsic radiation. This is critical for the research of biological objects in their native state, as well as for investigating living systems (including human organism) in natural environments. It has been shown that mm-wave negative fluxes possess high therapeutic efficiency. Positive results of clinical investigations suggest that medical applications of mm-wave negative fluxes look quite promising within the framework of studying the origin of pain, as well as in developing new methods for pain syndrome relief. All this gives grounds for optimistic forecasts regarding mm-wave negative flux applications in physical experiments, as well as in medical diagnostics and practice.

articleTitle: Estimation of communication networks efficiency
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: We considered three typical cases of comparative estimation of communication network efficiency with uncertainty of efficiency dependence on the network performance and infallibility.

articleTitle: Stripline coupler for calibrating measuring systems
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The calculation and modeling of a 3 dB directional coupler, on connected striplines, using Microwave Office 2002 software, was carried out. A development prototype was built, and the calculations and experimental performance of the coupler are presented.

articleTitle: Physically realizable characteristics of compensators distorting millimeter-wave signals in absorbing media
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: We consider indispensable and sufficient conditions for the physical realizability of frequency functions of any passive compensators distorting millimeter-wave signals.

articleTitle: Investigation of microstrip models of filters on the base of crystal superlattices with "washed out" boundaries between the layers
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The construction of microstrip models of bandpass filters based on superlattices with different laws of permittivity constant change on the interface between the layers are investigated. It is shown that responses do not depend on the form of interface when thickness of transient region is less than 1/4 of structure period. Quasistatic analysis of one-dimensional microstrip models agrees with experiment well.

articleTitle: Forecasting of training efficiency of the telecommunication systems' operators using structural educational models
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The method of developing training models (TM) for telecommunication operators is studied. The operator training process (OTP) in the field of telecommunications is a specific process. Using well-known educational models (EMs), it is not possible to take into consideration separately the contribution of teachers (subjects) and learners (objects) to assimilating professional activity and technical, programme, didactic and other means of labour in OTP efficiency. A method is proposed to develop a new class of EM with penetration to the structure of the educational process. Structural EMs, compared to traditional ones, give more information for working out practical recommendations of training improvement.

articleTitle: Research of complex signal passing through nonlinear transmission line on magnetostatic waves
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A microstrip line with a ferromagnetic film excited by a magnetostatic wave (MSW) is a nonlinear device referred to as a signal-to-noise enhancer. In such a transmission line and in the frequency range of MSW excitation, a signal, whose power level is below some threshold value, is more attenuated than a signal whose power level is higher than the threshold value. On the basis of experimental data, an attempt is made to construct a nonlinear model of a backward volume MSW (BVMSW) transmission line. This model describes the frequency characteristics of such a line in the cases of one and two signal regimes.

articleTitle: Wave-like processes in Smith-Purcell amplifier with the metal-dielectric layer
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Recently, attention has been paid to the creation of new generator and amplifier modifications which use diffraction (Smith-Purcell) and Cerencov radiations. In particular, an amplifier model based on a two-mirror open waveguide (OW) stimulated by diffraction volume wave radiation was investigated (Vorobjov, G.S., et al., 1998; 2001). The paper describes theoretical and experimental investigations of an amplifier electrodynamics system, which consists of a periodic structure and metal-dielectric layers and is based on the Smith-Purcell effect.

articleTitle: The processes of blowup and formation of self-similar plasma-field structures in the continuum medium under influence of the concentrated streams of energy
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Plasma-field structures arise under the effect of pulsed energy sources onto the surface of condensed media. As pulsed sources, in the experiments carried out at "Proton-21" Electrodynamic Laboratory, we used relativistic electron beams with currents higher than 100 kA. Those REBs were generated in high-current diodes. As a result of the experiments, we have recorded regions in the anode with extreme parameters. The densities in those regions exceeded by several orders of magnitude the densities in the metals, with their temperature being on the order of several keV.

articleTitle: Synthesis of optimal gyrotron resonator profiles with the use of T-functions apparatus
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The synthesis of gyrotron resonator structures operating in H/sub 0i/ modes is presented on the basis of the T-function theory and the technique for exact multimode calculations of irregular waveguides. These structures provide optimal distribution for two types of fields: unimodal and multi-extreme (multistage resonator). Exact conformity between calculated and published experimental data has been established.

articleTitle: Synthesis of a noiseproof signal in non-linear radiolocation
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The article describes a way of detecting non-linear electronic objects with robust signals. More accurate results are achieved by transformation of the transmitted and received signals.

articleTitle: The influence of transverse sizes upon characteristics of single-electron transistor
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The modified physical model of a metal single-electron transistor (SET) was proposed. On the basis of the model, transverse sizes influence of structure on I-V characteristics was investigated.

articleTitle: 'Phasagraph M' telecommunications system for monitoring and researching environmental influences on human organism
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The paper suggests implementing telecommunications technologies to carry out research experiments using similar hardware in different cities with subsequent processing of the results at a central server under a common protocol. Results of such implementation in the area of biophysical monitoring experiments using the 'Phasagraph M' system are presented.

articleTitle: The chaotic encoding algorithm on the basis of two-dimensional mapping
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The structure of the phase space of the discrete encoding algorithm with two-dimensional (2D) mapping and delay was investigated. It was shown that the sequences formed by the algorithm have statistical attributes satisfying the requirements made for encoding signals for digital telecommunication systems.

articleTitle: Ring resonator prototype for high-power tests of microwave components
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A microwave resonant ring with a traveling TE/sub 01/ wave for high power tests of components was developed. Novel low-loss miter bends with flat mirrors and mode converters were used in the resonator. Low power measurements were carried out - the maximum gain factor exceeds 35 at an operating frequency of 34.272 GHz. Total quality is about 21400. In this case, the reflection coefficient from the resonator is less than 1 %.

articleTitle: Accounting set of chaotic binary codes
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The creation of an accounting set of binary orthogonal chaotic sequences is numerically investigated on the basis of a base sequence with use of a time delay about the characteristic period of the chaotic function. A method of formation of a base chaotic binary sequence is offered using a temporary realization of chaotic function.

articleTitle: Waveguide measurement technique for the complex permittivity of materials
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The waveguide technique of measuring the complex permittivity of materials is considered. The exact electrodynamical model of the sensor similar to a dielectric tube in a rectangular waveguide is used for a solution of an inverse electrodynamical task that allows reducing the error of measurement results.

articleTitle: Transmitting and receiving optical modules based on edge-emitting LED
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The basic characteristics of transmitting and receiving optical modules based on edge-emitting light-emitting diode (LED) with angled active region are considered. These modules are intended for transfer of the digital information to TTL levels in a range of working temperatures from minus 40/spl deg/C up to +55/spl deg/C.

articleTitle: Systems analysis and sinergetic as a methodology in a modern technical education
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The work considers system-sinergetic methods and their application in the teaching of humanitarian disciplines in technical universities. The author has analyzed the opportunities and advantages of the application of this methodology in modern theoretical research and education processes.

articleTitle: Controlled 3-cm range waveguide ferrite polarizer
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: We have measured the dependence of the rotation direction of the radial magnetic component of a wave on the external magnetic field of a 3-cm range waveguide ferrite polarizer. This polarizer is a section of circular waveguide with a rectangular ferrite plate in the external magnetic field of a solenoid.

articleTitle: Simulating 3D electron-optical systems of microwave vacuum devices with shadow grids
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A technique for simulating electron-optical systems comprising grids, collectors and magnetic systems is discussed. An operative 2D code was initially used to calculate basic parameters, following which the effects of asymmetries were investigated using 3D codes. The results are presented of simulating electron-optical systems to shape the high-perveance (P/sub /spl mu// /spl sim/ 1.3 /spl mu/A/V/sup 3/2/) electron stream in a channel and a two-stage collector.

articleTitle: Experimental and theoretical research of the synchronization of oscillations in the backward wave oscillator
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Synchronization of the oscillations in the "electron-beam with backward electromagnetic wave" system (BWO) is investigated theoretically and experimentally. The characteristics of non-autonomous oscillations are examined; physical processes in the distributed auto-oscillation system transiting to synchronization regime are analysed.

articleTitle: The influence of coherent and incoherent transmission on I-V characteristics of RTD
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The influence of coherent and incoherent transmission on the RTD's I-V characteristics was investigated. We assume scattering rate dependence upon all resonant levels when calculating optical potential. Calculations were performed using a combined single-band model with scattering and one based on self-consistent solution of the Schrodinger and Poisson equations.

articleTitle: Polarization patterns of reflector antenna with circular polarization feed
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Equations to calculate near-field radiation of an hemispherical spiral irradiator are presented. The optimal number of spiral irradiator coils for application in reflector antennas is determined. It is also established that circular polarization eliminates an additional cross-polarized component under signal re-reflection.

articleTitle: Investigation into the interaction of microwave radiation with live blood cells
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: MM waves are known to influence metabolic processes in biological systems (for example, ATP synthesis, ion transport through cell membranes, regulatory processes, etc.) and to have therapeutic effects on certain diseases. At the same time, the understanding of the physical mechanisms behind the interaction of weak electromagnetic waves with live cells falls behind practical applications of MM waves in medicine. The mechanisms behind the effect of MM waves on animal cells remain uninvestigated, while techniques and biological models for their research are still to be developed. Investigations into a model cell system have allowed for recommendations to be developed for the stimulation or inhibition of certain cell functions occurring in various impairments. A possibility of developing a conceptually new microwave diagnostics technique with the goal of increasing the resistance of biological cells has been shown.

articleTitle: Coupled slot in a narrow wall of a rectangular waveguide
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The possibility of expansion of the functional properties of slot antennas and SHF devices depends upon the available components. A computational method is developed to calculate the power characteristics of doubled inclined slots called coupled slots cut in the narrow wall of the rectangular waveguide and penetrating into the top and bottom broad walls.

articleTitle: Dielcometry of polar liquid crystals in Nuclepore membranes at microwaves
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A technique for measuring the permittivity of liquid crystals (LC) confined in Nuclepore membranes with a low porosity (1.3 %) is described. A microstrip resonator with capacitive cell for investigating the MW-permittivity is described. It is shown that the permittivity of a LC may be measured with 3.2/spl plusmn/0.15 accuracy.

articleTitle: The phase space of the digital encoding algorithm for telecommunication systems
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: We investigate the phase space structure of a discrete algorithm with delay determined on the integer number interval. The Fibonacci-type mechanism of chaotization was added by a mixing transformation at the bound violation of the definite region of value. It was found that the phase space of the system consisted of a finite number of different cycles and the system's behavior has pseudo-random character. It was shown that under the condition of proper choice of value the algorithm allows us to form a nonperiodic pseudorandom sequence of the prescribed length for coding of information in telecommunication systems.

articleTitle: Permittivity measurement by partly filled resonator method
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The method of complex permittivity measurement by partly filled resonator is considered. The simplest model-like transcendental equation is used. Curves showing the dependence of the H/sub 111/ wave resonant frequency on sample permittivity and infill level are obtained.

articleTitle: Electronic magazines in assistance to science and education
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The article considers the question of information support of tutorial and scientific processes in the SevNTU library. It presents experience of library work with EBSCO Publishing databases in the INTAS project.

articleTitle: Groove guide control elements
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The possibility of creation, polarization and amplitude control elements based on the groove guide detector is considered.

articleTitle: Solid-state microwave low-power oscillators (to 60-years of Federal State Unitary Enterprise "Research and Production Corporation ISTOK")
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The work presents a classification of microwave low-power oscillators, and devices based on them, developed and produced in the FSUE "RPC ISTOK". Microwave oscillators are low-power devices with diversity of characteristics and application fields. The majority of solid-state microwave oscillators are executed using hybrid-integral technology and microstrip lines. We have created more than 120 types of oscillators and devices based on them, which are used in more than 30 systems of onboard and ground equipment in military and civil applications.

articleTitle: Selecting and calculating oscillating system for a non-/spl pi/-mode magnetron
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: An advanced technique for calculating oscillatory system parameters of MM-wave magnetrons utilizing non-/spl pi/-mode oscillations is discussed.

articleTitle: PIC simulation of powerful microwave coaxial ubitron
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Results of numerical simulation of a powerful coaxial UHF-ubitron are given. We received these results using the numerical 2.5-dimensional electromagnetic code, which we developed. This code is based on the PIC method. In the work the algorithm adapted to the coaxial ubitron geometry is described. The numerical analysis of ubitron operation in amplification and in generation regimes is given.

articleTitle: Magnetic focusing system for hybrid FEL-based on quadrupole lenses
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The hybrid FEL with a focusing system consisting of a quadrupole lens chain placed in a longitudinal magnetic field is presented in this work. Preliminary results of experimental research of the electron beam formed by quadrupole systems in two cases in continuous and pulsing regimes are presented. We detected wideband spontaneous radiation of the electron beam moving by curvilinear trajectories.

articleTitle: Nonlinear regimes of coaxial gyro-BWO
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Nonlinear generation regimes of coaxial gyro-BWO were investigated. The results allow determination of necessary parameters of gyro-BWO (beam current, system length) for reception of required modes of generation (stationary, self-modulation and stochastic modes).

articleTitle: New approaches to instant diagnostics and monitoring of therapeutic process dynamics
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A new approach to instant diagnostics and monitoring of therapeutic process dynamics for various pathological and functional changes in the human body is proposed. Clinical investigations into the complex admittance variations at biologically active points in the course of therapeutic procedures using EHF electromagnetic radiation have been conducted.

articleTitle: Effect of dielectrics on radiating characteristics and directional properties of waveguide-slot antennas
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Insertion of dielectrics into microwave and millimeter wave devices changes their fabrication method. The effects of dielectric loading of waveguide and slot volumes and also of dielectric coating on radiating and directional characteristics of waveguide-slot antennas is investigated.

articleTitle: Correcting ability and bounds of matroid codes
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Linear block codewords consist of information and control parts. Absences of such sharing (division) are distinctive particularities of matroid codes. In this case, any k symbols from n of the received codeword can be used to restore the original sequence. New results in matroid (M-)code parameters are presented in this work. We establish the dependences of the codeword length n from parameters t and k. Lower and upper bounds of M-code existences over the field GF/sup k/(2/sup m/) for t and k fixed are found.

articleTitle: Microstrip sensor of magnetic fields
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Using a quasi-static approximation, the construction of a weak magnetic field sensor containing a thin magnetic film is researched and optimised. A sensitivity comparison of the sensor with a polycrystalline Permalloy film and the sensor with a monocrystalline yttrium-iron garnet film is carried out.

articleTitle: Multilevel transceiver modeling and simulation
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: We consider simulation techniques for RF circuits and systems and different modeling levels. The probable ways to combine models of different levels within one design environment are proposed and a multilevel modeling and simulation framework structure is substantiated. A new implementation of such an environment is described. It allows usage of different level models in one simulation process. In order to provide detailed simulation of the communication link, different system level techniques and models should used. They may be combined via co-simulation, or using macro (behavioral) modeling approaches. Correspondent modeling levels are shown. The required structure of the multilevel simulation framework is outlined and grounded. Usage of modern HDL is shown to be advisable. The structure of the simulation framework reflects the communication link structure. Such a structure is implemented by the author in the Rincon harmonic balance simulator using the Frequency Domain VHDL-AMS language extension. Its usage is illustrated in simulation of the communication transmitter outlined. It is described using behavioral models mostly, but some blocks are specified as netlists. Simulation results are presented.

articleTitle: Forming of AlGaAs nanodiode current-voltage characteristics
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The analytic formula for Al/sub x/Ga/sub 1-x/As resonant-tunneling diode current-voltage characteristic (VCC) is obtained. It is applicable at the following restrictions: (1) the voltage across the diode is less then U/sub peak/; (2) the mole fraction /spl times/ Al in barrier Al/sub x/Ga/sub 1-x/As layers is more than 0.4; and (3) thickness of well GaAs layer is from 5 to 10 GaAs layers. The diagrams (degree of power-behaved VCC parameters of layers) and technological parameter tolerance are obtained from this formula. VCC shape I/spl sim/U/sup n/ alters from n=1 up to n=5, when parameters of layers are changed. Parameters of layers were determined for I/spl sim/U/sup 3/ VCC, diodes were made and subharmonic mixers on their basis were investigated. Good agreement of experiments with the theory is obtained.

articleTitle: Tunable band-pass (BPF) and band-stop (BSF) filters based on magnetostatic spin waves (MSW) propagating in yttrium iron garnet (YIG) films grown by the liquid-phase epitaxy method
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: One of readily available applications for implementation of MSW-based devices is the creation of tunable band-pass and band-stop filters. MSW-based filters have a number of advantages compared to tuned filters based on YIG spheres. These advantages allow the design and production to begin for a number of BPF and BSF with electronic tuning operating in the centimeter frequency range. We have designed BPF and BSF with coaxial input and output as well as microstrip models. We have also created BPF and BSF with mechanical tuning only provided for the band centred within /spl plusmn/300 MHz relative to f/sub c/, which allowed considerable decrease of filter dimensions.

articleTitle: MMDS group TV signal transmitter
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The possibility of MMDS group TV signal transmitter creation is considered. The system of transmitting a group TV signal (up to 25 channels) in the MMDS range using one transmitter is known. The use of several one-channel transmitters instead of one group signal transmitter allows an increase in system reliability and repairability, lowers its cost and enables its introduction into operation in stages. The proposed method of using MMDS transmitters demands five antenna-feeders. That is the system's weak point. On the other hand, if one channel transmitter fails, it does not affect the others. Block construction allows the failed block to be changed quickly without switching off the others.

articleTitle: Radially-two-layer quasi-optical dielectric resonator with conductive end surface
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The characteristic equation for complex frequencies of a radially-two-layer dielectric cylindrical resonator bounded by conductive end walls was obtained. At filling of resonator internal layer by different substances, the expressions of eigen frequencies and Q-factors of resonators from internal layer radius are given in a millimeter waveband. The numerical research of the resonator characteristics is carried out for "whispering gallery" oscillation HE/sub 38/ /sub 10/. The possibility of such a resonator as a measuring cell for permittivity is shown for substances with both large and small losses.

articleTitle: Estimation of the opportunity of coaxial magnetron development in short-wave parts of the millimeter band
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The prospect of creating a coaxial magnetron (CM) for operation in the short-wave part of the millimeter wave band is discussed. One critical obstacle to creating such a CM is the technological difficulties in manufacturing electrodynamics systems. However, the basic obstacle becomes a growing difficulty when the tuning of the generation frequency is taken into account.

articleTitle: Theory of feedback in generators with virtual cathode. Analytical theory of virtual cathode
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The inhomogeneous problem of electric oscillation in the space with a virtual cathode was solved for the first time. These oscillation spectra were found to depend upon the cathode location (and consequently upon the cathode injection current). Frequency values and oscillation increments are given.

articleTitle: Spatial-temporal effects of microwave irradiation in biomedical experiments
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Spatial-temporal energy relations for a rectangular waveguide feed are considered. The therapeutic effect of a thermal MM-wave irradiation is linked to the concentration of electric field along the axis of a waveguide feeder which is in immediate contact with irradiated surfaces.

articleTitle: Metal-plate lenses in axisymmetric radiating systems
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A method of analysis of axisymmetric radiators with metal-plate lenses is proposed and realized. The focusing properties of radiating systems with metal-plate lenses are examined for a modeling radiating system, operating with H/sub 01/ mode of a circular waveguide.

articleTitle: A wavelet-based technique to decrease full-wave simulation time of microwave/mm-wave transistors
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A new wavelet-based simulation approach for the analysis and simulation of microwave/mm-wave transistors is presented. For the first time in the literature, the Daubechies-based wavelet approach is applied to semiconductor equations to generate a nonuniform mesh. This allows the forming of fine and coarse grids in locations where variable solutions change rapidly and slowly, respectively. The procedure of nonuniform mesh generation is described in detail by simulating a MESFET. It is shown that good accuracy can be achieved while compressing the number of unknowns by 70%.

articleTitle: Edge magnetoplasmons in a weakly disordered array of two-dimensional electron gas strips
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The paper deals with the theoretical investigation of edge magnetoplasmon spectrum of the weakly disordered array of two-dimensional electron gas strips, consisting of a finite number of strips, arranged at equal distance from each other. The densities of electrons were equal in all two-dimensional electron gas strips except one defect strip.

articleTitle: The library of basic components of MMIC fabricated by Istok
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The formation of a library of active and passive components of MMICs fabricated by "Istok" is described. The library is created for Istok's proprietary MMIC CAD software "FAGOT-M". To create the library, we chose CAD Microwave Office due to its availability and friendly user interface. Microwave Office allows the creation of user libraries in XML technology. It enables an electrical model (defined by equivalent circuit or a set of S-parameters) to be connected with each basic component.

articleTitle: A 6-18 GHz broadband power amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Presented are the results of elaboration of solid-state amplifiers with output power 300 mW at 1 dB gain compression designed to be used in power vacuum/solid-state amplifiers. There are also construction schemes and experimental characteristics. The use of a solid-state amplifier as a preliminary amplifier for ultrawideband vacuum modules allows reduction of the noise factor of the transmitter and its dimensions. Two types of 6-18 GHz power amplifiers with gains of 20-25 dB and 30-35 dB respectively have been designed for the application as a component of the vacuum/solid-state module. The amplifiers are manufactured in accordance with a hybrid-integral technology.

articleTitle: Bound ferrite-dielectric resonators in over-range section of the waveguide
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The theory of calculation of amplitude-frequency characteristics of bound ferrite-dielectric resonators in over-range section of the waveguide is created. The most essential factors influential in band and energy properties of the structure are established. Pathways of the VHF filters' building using electrical means are shown.

articleTitle: Four-element array module of radio telescope 60/150 PRAO LPI
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: One of the linear antenna array versions consisting of four log-periodical (60-150) MHz antennas is considered as an array module of 4/spl times/4 elements. This module is intended to be a component of new meter wave radio telescope.

articleTitle: Circular polarization X-band selector
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Circular polarization is used in the X-band, so polarizers are necessary components of a antenna-feeding channel. The work considers an X-band polarization selector for transforming linear polarization into circular polarizations. The polarization selector considered is a square waveguide separated in the center with a tapered metallic plate forming three inputs, two with rectangular and one with square cross-sections. The polarization selector developed provides the required ellipticity of 0.8 within a 15% frequency band (7.2-8.4 GHz).

articleTitle: 2- and 8-GHz radiometers for Simeyiz VLBI Station
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The 2- and 8-GHz uncooled LNAs for VLBI radiometers were installed in Radio Telescope 22 at the Crimean Astrophysical Observatory (Simeyiz Station). The horizontal velocity of the Simeyiz Radio-Astronomical Station displacement was estimated using VLBI observations carried out under geodynamics programs. The station was found to move north-east at a rate of 2.8/spl plusmn/0.9 mm/yr relative to the Eurasian tectonic plate considered as rigid.

articleTitle: Microwave solid-state power amplifiers - state-of-the-art and future trends
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: We consider the world technical achievements and tendencies in the development of microwave and millimeter-wave transistor high power amplifiers, microwave transistors and MMIC.

articleTitle: An experimental extraction of low noise field effect transistor's linear equivalent circuit and noise model
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: An experimental extraction of a low noise field effect transistor's linear equivalent circuit and noise model is presented. The linear equivalent circuits and noise models are extracted for two types of FET (3P374A-5 manufactured by joint-stock company "Planet-GaAs", "Sozvezdiye-P" manufactured by FSUC RPC "Istok") and two types PHEMT manufactured by FSUC RPC "Istok" (molecular beam epitaxy structure and metalorganic vapor phase epitaxy structure).

articleTitle: Modeling of spin-dependent transport in ferromagnet/insulator/ferromagnet structures
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A model of spin-dependent electron tunneling through ferromagnet/insulator/ferromagnet structure is developed. It is based on the Schrodinger equation and free-electron approximation. Variation of magnetoresistance with applied voltage is examined.

articleTitle: Effect of laser processing on gallium arsenide device structures
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Some aspects of laser processing application in the formation of gallium arsenide surface-barrier structures and ohmic contacts for them are considered on the basis of analysis of experimental results known from literature, as well as those obtained by the author.

articleTitle: MESFET amplifier with second harmonic tuning
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: An experimental prototype of an amplifier with tuning on the second harmonics was built and investigated. It is shown that there are variants of tuning for ensuring high efficiency at low transistor supply voltage.

articleTitle: Criteria for broadbandness estimation in scanning waveguide antenna arrays
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The broadbandness estimation of scanning waveguide antenna arrays under the criteria of given relative operation frequency bandwidth, frequency band and engagement factor is presented. Dependencies of maximum operation frequency bandwidth on arrangement geometry of radiators with complex cross-section are obtained for single waveguide and single beamwidth mode of antenna operation. Design equations for the estimation of operation frequency bandwidth are presented for chosen radiator sizes and geometry of phased antenna arrays (array spacing, angle of radiator arrangement in the oblique coordinates).

articleTitle: Application of high-altitude platform systems in regions of disaster and emergency
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: We present the original concept of HAPS operation in disaster regions and emergency situations. According to the concept, HAPS should execute two primal aims: remote sensing and ensuring facilities of communication and broadcasting in disaster regions. Thus, the pilotless flying vehicle "Faeton" is offered as an aeroplatform.

articleTitle: Measurement of parameters of thin film semiconductor structures by means of help millimeter waves
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A new method based on application of millimeter waves for measurement of complex refractive index of thin semiconductor films on high resistive substrates is described.

articleTitle: The complex of equipment for digital TV transmission through the analogous radio relay link
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Transmission of television (TV) signals in digital form is one of the ways for analogous radio relay station (RRS) life prolongation. This solution increases the radio relay link RRL's capacity, making integration with data transmission systems possible. The usage of digital modulation techniques and antinoise coding allows an increase in the distance of RRL (due to regeneration of the digital signal by the repeater stations). Characteristics of the complex of equipment for several TV programs' transmission through the analogous (RRL) are considered.

articleTitle: Automatic calibration of the vector network analyzer
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: In this paper, two block diagrams of the autocalibrating device are considered. For a vector network analyser (VNA) with an autocalibrating device, operating in the centimeter range, the reflection measurement error and transfer parameters are evaluated.

articleTitle: The three-band non adjustable polarization selector on the basis of two coaxials
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Results of development the three-band non adjustable polarization selector (frequencies f/sub 1/, f/sub 2/=1.15/spl times/f/sub 1/, and f/sub 3/=2/spl times/f/sub 1/) with ellipticity of 0.7-0.8 and VSWR<1.25 are reported. In the selector, coaxials with wave H/sub 11/ and new technical solutions are used to form the input frequency diplexer, polarizers and coaxial-to-waveguide junctions.

articleTitle: Digital signal processing system of the PRAO RT 60/150 radio telescope antenna unit
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Practical and theoretical aspects of applying digital techniques to temporal beam shaping and signal processing in a meter-wave radio telescope are discussed. At present, digital signal processing (DSP) techniques are receiving primary attention in the design of new radio telescopes. The implementation of these techniques allows for more reliable and flexible systems to be created. The value of systems using DSP would particularly grow in connection with rough and unpredictable interference environments at radio telescope sites. A new 60-150 MHz meter-wave radio telescope under development is expected to provide simultaneous monitoring in several directions (2-3 beams), continuous tracking of investigated objects, signal reception and recording across several frequency ranges. The report discusses the issues of practically implementing DSP techniques in beam shaping, multibeam reception and in the analysis of radio telescope signals. The technique, circuit and program solutions will be fine-tuned using an existing PRAO DKR-1000 LPI radio telescope.

articleTitle: Simulation of monolithic planar transformers on a GaAs-substrate
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The results of simulation of GaAs transformers are given. An algorithm for automatic changing of construction parameters is offered. This work presents the analysis of inductances of windings and S-parameters of the transformer.

articleTitle: Features of lower ionosphere dynamics conditioned by morning solar terminator
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Experimental investigations into the electron density variations in the middle latitude D-region during the morning solar terminator passage have been conducted applying the partial reflections technique. Approximately 50-150% increase in the electron density was discovered during the morning solar terminator passage and afterwards. Within the context of the hypothesis for electron eruptions from the magnetosphere, calculations have been carried out, and a possible mechanism for the electron eruption caused by the morning solar terminator has been shown.

articleTitle: The eigenvector-based identification of shallow buried targets in ground penetrating radar
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A new approach to the super-resolution eigenvector method implementation, in step-frequency ground penetrating radar (GPR), is proposed. The pseudospectrum determination, fulfilled by the eigenvector algorithm, is followed by a procedure of more precise signal parameter estimation. Accordingly, the distance to the object obtained by the eigenvector algorithm is considered more reliable. Then, complex amplitudes of the determined signal components are calculated, which allows distinguishing different types of buried objects.

articleTitle: Investigation, research and manufacture of SOI structures to produce integrated circuits and different devices of microelectronics
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: In the future special microelectronics solutions will allow the developing of separate segments of commercial electronics on the world level. As a result of research the manufacturing route is developed and samples of SOI structures are obtained by the method of bonding and gas splitting. Silicon wafer surfaces and instrument layers obtained by methods of bonding are investigated. The results of sample characteristics research allow the availability of the chosen technological process of the wafer clearing process in manufacturing of SOI structures and expediency of similar manufacture at microelectronics enterprises.

articleTitle: Multilayer microwave absorber
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The problem of microwave signal reflection and absorption by multilayer lossy media is solved. The optimum structure of an absorber is developed for the minimum number of layers. The space-time structure of the electromagnetic field reflected by the multilayer structure is investigated by the Fourier method.
