articleTitle: Academician A. Ya. Usikov - founder and first director of the Institute for Radiophysics and Electronics, NAS of Ukraine
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: This work is dedicated to the life and activities of Alexander Yakovlevich Usikov, an outstanding scientist, Academician of the National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine, winner of national prizes of Ukraine and USSR. His 100/sup th/ anniversary is widely celebrated this year. A. Usikov's contribution into the development of electronics and radiophysics, radiolocation, and quantum electronics is universally recognised by leading scientists. He was the founder and first director of the NASU Institute for Radiophysics and Electronics located in Kharkiv, an institution well-known to the global research community. In 1996 the IRE was named after Academician Alexander Usikov.

articleTitle: Microelectromechanical analog phase shifter simulation
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A study on optimal design of a centimeter and millimeter wave MEMS phase shifter is presented. It is shown that micro movement of dielectric and metal bodies over the microstrip or coplanar line can provide full phase modulation without introducing extra loss.

articleTitle: Variety of education in Europe - shared goals for 2010
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Declarations accentuate the significance of mutual European exchange in order to ensure the quality of education. The guarantee of such co-operation is the so-called accreditation carried out by national quality agencies. The Lisbon Convention is an official structure for acknowledging professional qualifications issued by institutions of the tertiary level belonging to national educational systems.

articleTitle: Microwave signal processing using dipole-exchange spin waves
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The possibility of the application of dipole-exchange spin waves (DESW) in ferrite (yttrium-iron garnet or YIG) films for microwave signal processing is investigated. The short-wavelength DESW were excited as a result of scattering of an input long-wavelength dipolar spin wave pulse on inhomogeneities in the YIG film.

articleTitle: Dynamics of lipid properties as a possible factor in improving mm-wave diagnostics of atherosclerosis
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Atherosclerosis usually results from lipid deposition on artery walls with subsequent enlargement of intima connective tissue and atherosclerotic plaque formation. Investigations into piezo- and ferroelectric properties of the lipids have revealed the impact of phase transformations on the process of atherosclerotic plaque formation. The conceptual framework of the physics of living organisms considers EM mm waves to be immanent to all living things. In view of this, the dynamics of the lipid properties (bearing in mind their diagnostic applications) should be studied with the aid of these waves, making the most of their principal properties, including polarization and its effects.

articleTitle: Parameter calculation of 8 mm two-stage orotron amplifier
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The parameter calculation for a theoretical model of a two-stage orotron amplifier is presented. Nonlinear differential equations describing the electron-wave interaction in both stages are solved. Theoretical values of electron efficiency are compared with experimental data for a 2.5 kW 8 mm amplifier studied earlier by the authors.

articleTitle: Low-frequency transversal instability of ion flow moving in high-current REB
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: LF processes can play a significant role in powerful microwave generators with plasma filling based on high current REB (relativistic electron beam). The paper studies the instability of an LF wave in ion flow during acceleration by a space charge wave in a collective ion accelerator based on high current REB, modulated in time and in space.

articleTitle: Gyroklinotron simulation and optimization by efficiency
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Averaged efficiency is shown to reach 55% in gyroklinotrons (gyrotrons with a two-mirror box-shaped open resonator and a wide electron stream, ES, tilted about the resonator axis) for optimized ES tilting angles.

articleTitle: Source of electromagnetic signal on the base of explosive devices
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The test equipment for plasma jet excitation and test results for plasma antennas excited by means of spark-gap converter and RF explosive magnetic generator with a plasma antenna are presented.

articleTitle: Formation of high-conducting nanostructures in low-conducting diamond-like carbon films using SPM-lithograph
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Low-conducting hydrogenated diamond-like carbon (DLC) a-C:H films were examined for the purpose of nanometer-scaled modifications under the action of local electrical field. The capabilities of SPM technique for preparation of conducting nanostructures in the low-conducting a-C:H films have been demonstrated for the first time.

articleTitle: Waveguide-slot antenna with longitudinal dielectric slab retarding system
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The radiation and directional properties of a system with longitudinal slots in a rectangular waveguide having a longitudinal dielectric slab inside are examined. It is shown that the system's operational frequency band is wider then that of a hollow waveguide configuration. However, the main beam radiation pattern is wider and the side lobes have a higher level. Nevertheless, the gain of the antenna with dielectric is 1.5-2 times higher at maximum frequencies than that for the hollow waveguide.

articleTitle: Broadband physical optics simulations of large multi-reflector antennas for radioastronomy
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Challenges and solutions concerning the accurate electromagnetic simulations of large multi-reflector antennas for deep-space submillimeter-wave radioastronomy are considered. The current status of the ESA Planck HFI beam simulation is presented. Gaussian fitting of the computed beams is performed.

articleTitle: Near-field microwave radiometric temperature monitoring of heated and cooled living tissues
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Using the dependence of the shaping depth of the received thermal radio emission on the apertures of small contact probes used as antennas in microwave radiometers, the temperature profile dynamics in subcutaneous human tissues subjected to heating and cooling have been retrieved according to the measured dynamics of the received signal. For the experiment, a human hand was heated (or cooled) in water, and temperature variations in hot (or cold) water with subsequent relaxation in air were measured using contact antennas with sizes of 0.5, 1, 2, and 3 cm and a radiometer at 31 cm wavelength. Antennas were matched both to water and living tissues. Similar radiometric measurements in air and the recovery of the temperature relaxation processes in the human body following a 100-second heating are presented. The results show that relaxation processes in the near-surface layer commence immediately, while with deeper layers, the heating still continues for some time. The developed single-wave technique of subcutaneous temperature profile recovery might prove efficient for medical applications in monitoring internal body temperatures during microwave hyperthermia treatment.

articleTitle: Application of Kramers-Kronig dispersion relations for processing of magnetic spectra of SHF [ferrites]
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The frequency dependences of magnetic permeability of ferrites with a BaCo/sub 2/-/sub x/Zn/sub x/Fe/sub 18/O/sub 27/ (Co/sub 2-x/Zn/sub x/W) system hexagonal structure are submitted in the frequency range of the natural ferromagnetic resonance. Investigations are carried out at frequencies of 0.1-27 GHz. The coordination of the results of measurement spectra of the real and imaginary parts of the permeability was carried out with the help of Kramers-Kronig dispersion relations.

articleTitle: Permissible frequency functions of distortion correctors of millimeter-wave pulse signals at their distribution in atmosphere
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: We mark some general analytical properties of frequency functions of correctors of distortion from the linearity, reciprocity, stationarity and passivity of correctors.

articleTitle: Material thickness decrease influence at measurements of dielectric permeability
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: An opportunity for the optimization of the construction of microwave resonant coaxial gauges used for the control of the dielectric permeability of sheet materials is considered.

articleTitle: The broadband multichannel microwave beam switches with the optimized parameters
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Multichannel switches with L-type elementary keys on p-i-n diodes are investigated. Simple ways are suggested to increase the cut-off frequency and to improve channel isolation by choice of an appropriate p-i-n diode operating regime and by using an additional RC-sub circuit.

articleTitle: Methodological fundamentals of engineering education
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The work considers problems which are methodological fundamentals of engineering education. General tasks of higher education are discussed. The authors conclude that fundamental education must be inherent in technical universities. We discuss the basic principles of teaching in school and present recommendations for better organisation of the educational process. The basic requirements regarding teacher training during postgraduate study are formulated. These questions have to be solved by every teacher individually on the one hand, and by university departments, universities and the Ministry of Education on the other hand.

articleTitle: Fundamental students training in technical universities
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The paper discusses methods of training students in physics and mathematics as a basic subjects in the course of forming a future engineer.

articleTitle: Peculiarities of microwave plasma forming conditions at low vacuum in plasmatron with rectangular form resonator
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The results are presented of measuring a series of electrophysical characteristics determining the operation of a microwave plasma generator based on a rectangular resonator with partial filling of the resonating volume with plasma. It was established that the allocation of a microwave field and local electrical plasma, with conductivity according to the length of the discharge area, carries a periodic character with alternating maxima and minima. The changes of temperature values have a rather smooth shape with a small rise near the place of microwave energy input to the resonator. Because of a space inhomogeneity in the parameters of the microwave discharge, plasma generators of a given type at microwave power density values of up to 7.104 W/m/sup 3/ brought to the discharge are reasonable to use for non-precision plasma processes such as interoperating processes for activation of the substrate surfaces of integrated circuits, cleaning off lacquers and polish, plasma-chemical removal of photoresistant film coats, etc.

articleTitle: Simulating a multibeam electron-optical system of a transparent mini-TWT
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The results are presented of simulating a 36-beam electron stream shaping system for a 'transparent' mini-TWT built on permanent magnets. The physical nature of limitations on the multibeam electron stream transmission through thin (0.4 mm) transit channels has been studied. The level of the stream transmission is determined by the amplitude of the magnetic field transverse component in a gap between the poles of a magnetic system. Optimization criteria for such magnetic systems are proposed. A complete delivery of the multibeam stream to the collector is provided.

articleTitle: Theoretical and experimental study of chaotic oscillations in electron beam with virtual cathode
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The paper deals with theoretical and experimental research of oscillatory processes in an electron beam with virtual cathode (VC). The purpose of this work is the investigation of the physical mechanisms which lead to chaotic generation in systems with VC (vircators).

articleTitle: Modelling of quantum wires on various materials accounting the effect of scattering
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: We performed modeling of quantum wires made of various semiconductor materials, taking into account the effect of scattering of carriers by potential. Two models in the Wigner function formalism were applied for the analysis. The models have been incorporated into the NANODEV simulation system.

articleTitle: Method of estimation the wideband characteristics of printed antennas on the basis of non-uniform slot line
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A method is proposed for the preliminary estimation of the wideband properties of traveling-wave radiators based on an inhomogeneous slot line. The method permits a preliminary estimation of the operating frequency band of the radiator using equivalent circuit schemes and without electrodynamic modeling. Theoretical and experimental results for a Vivaldi radiator in the 0.5-4 GHz frequency band are presented.

articleTitle: EHF oscillator with frequency multiplication
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The design of an extremely-high frequency (EHF) oscillator with frequency multiplication built around microwave semiconductor diodes is presented. The device is intended for use in medical applications and has to provide a higher operating frequency range, and deliver coherent emission. One way to tackle these problems is to multiply the frequency of the original highly-coherent Gunn-diode signal by a multiplier component built around a Schottky diode. The work presents the technique for designing a highly-coherent 75-160 GHz EHF EMR source on the basis of commercially available 37-40 GHz Gunn diodes and multiplier Schottky diodes manufactured under a planar technology. The suggested concept offers a cost-effective upgrade for commercially produced EHF-therapy equipment.

articleTitle: The chaotic encoding algorithm with two delay parameters
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: By numerical methods the investigation and comparison of the statistical properties of pseudo-random sequences formed by the discrete Fibonacci-type algorithm with one and two parameters of delay for a digital system of communication were carried out.

articleTitle: Phase noise measurement of radio-electronic devices using special methods
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Phase noise measurement results for various devices (microcircuits, generators) are presented. The measurements were provided using special Aeroflex Automatic Phase Noise Test System PN9000.

articleTitle: Efficient scheme of Hough transform computing for videosequence compression
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: With the rise of high-speed communication channels a need for new, more efficient video stream compression algorithms has appeared. These algorithms involve both image filtering and segmentation. These tasks can be efficiently solved using the Hough transform. Preliminary sample smoothing is needed for Hough transform stability. Generally, the smoothing level is not given in advance. So, a parameter fitting scheme should be used. However, that leads to multiple calculations of the Hough transform. We show that a smoothing transform in the Hough space exists, which is equivalent to preliminary sample smoothing. Such a scheme is much more efficient.

articleTitle: Application of the microstrip resonators for measuring small values of permittivity in SHF range
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The paper investigates the effects of a lumped capacity for a microstrip resonator (MSR) and the distance of the connection point of the external transmission lines (ETL) from the end of the strip conductor on the frequency of an attenuation pole (AP) in the MSR frequency response.

articleTitle: Broadband hybrid double balanced mixer
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: We present the results of hybrid-integrated circuit (IC) design of a broadband double-balanced diode mixer which provides a broad operating frequency band of the signal and heterodyne at high de-coupling and low ripple of the conversion loss frequency characteristic.

articleTitle: Ohmic and barrier contacts to SiC- and GaN-based microwave diodes
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The Au-TiB/sub x/(Ti)-Al-Ti-n-GaN ohmic contacts and Au-ZrB/sub x/-n-6H-SiC barrier contacts were studied before and after rapid thermal annealing at T=700 and 800/spl deg/C. We measured the component concentration depth profiles and electrical characteristics of the contact systems. It was shown that TiB/sub x/ buffer layers are promising for application in ohmic contacts to n-GaN and ZrB/sub x/ in barrier contacts to n-6H SiC.

articleTitle: Information learning system on telecommunications "INFUS/spl I.bar/TK"
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The structure and realization of an information learning system on telecommunications (INFUS) is observed, and its general description is presented. INFUS is intended for specialists in telecommunication tools development. It also allows active implementation of computer-aided teaching and modern teaching methods, including distance learning on the Internet. Basic information of the system is presented on three CDs.

articleTitle: Calculation of shielded microstrip line with various configuration of resistance films in substrate
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: We describe the statement of a task concerning S-matrix calculation of the shielded microstrip line with resistance films in a two layer substrate. The results are presented.

articleTitle: The radio frequency electron gun model
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: One direction for the development of generators of electromagnetic oscillations is based on the use of relativistic electron beams. The resonance linear accelerator is the basic element of such devices. The quality of the electron beam at the exit of the accelerator is determined by the injector system in which it is formed. Injection systems based on radio frequency electron guns let us obtain the highest quality beams. A radio frequency electron gun is designed using a numerical model. The equation systems, numerical realization and examples of the calculation of different operating modes are presented. The simulation results agree with experimental ones. This allows us to recommend the model for the design of devices with the set parameters and described experimental results.

articleTitle: Control of oscillation modes in distributed beam-plasma system by means of continuous delay feedback
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The method of controlling complex dynamics of the distributed beam-plasma system with supercritical current with the help of delay feedback is studied.

articleTitle: The potential distribution approximation in an eccentric diode with current limited by space charge
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The approximation of potential distributions in an eccentric (noncoaxial) diode with current limited by space charge was calculated. It is shown that the eccentricity causes a decrease in the diode service life.

articleTitle: The influence of intervalley scattering on I-V characteristics of heterostructure with one tunnel junction and expanded near-contact regions
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The influence of coupling constant /spl alpha/ on I-V characteristics of a heterostructure with one tunnel junction and expanded near-contact regions was investigated. We show that it may cause a significant effect on I-V characteristic calculation results. Calculations were performed with the use of a combined two-band model based on self-consistent solution of the Schrodinger and Poisson equations. This model is a part of the nanoelectronic device simulation system NANODEV.

articleTitle: Modeling of radiation near-field pattern of hybrid-reflector antenna irradiated by conformal antenna array
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A mathematical model is presented for near-field radiation of an hybrid-spiral antenna, based on the Cassegrain antenna with the radiation system replaced by a conical spiral antenna array. The irradiating antenna array, installed on a conformal surface, consists of bilifar helix radiators, arranged on an hyperbolic surface.

articleTitle: Micromodular radiometer for temperature monitoring during microwave hyperthermia treatment
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A micromodular radiometric thermometer is described for thermal monitoring during intracavitary microwave hyperthermia treatment with ALMHP-01 Radmir apparatus. The design of the inexpensive radiometer is based on front-end RFICs. This design allows for the capabilities of microwave hyperthermia equipment to be expanded and for radiometers to be used in monitoring internal body temperatures during treatment.

articleTitle: Analysis of electrically long longitudinal slots system in broad wall of rectangular waveguide
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The analysis of electromagnetic wave radiation of two linear rectangular slots arbitrary oriented relative to each other is an important problem for analysis of waveguide-slot antenna arrays and also of complicated coupling elements in directional couplers, filters, and microwave power dividers. The problem of coupling the electrodynamic volumes through a system of electrically long longitudinal slots in the broad wall of a rectangular waveguide is solved by the induced magnetomotive forces method using adequate basis functions.

articleTitle: Switching radiometer
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The structure and algorithm of a switching radiometer intended for measuring the intensity of biological objects' UHF EM radiation are discussed. The proposed switching radiometer automatically keeps the temperature of the equivalent load terminating resistor equal to the applicator antenna temperature irrespective of its position on the biological object. The equality between the applicator antenna and equivalent load resistance is maintained at any object temperature. This ensures a balance between the noise levels of the applicator antenna and the antenna equivalent, as well as consistency of the microwave amplifier self-noise when the antenna is switched to its equivalent. Thus, the applicator antenna self-noise is corrected and the spurious modulation of the microwave amplifier self-noise is eliminated, offering increased accuracy of EM radiation power measurements deep inside biological objects displaying varying temperatures or intensities of pathological processes.

articleTitle: The manipulation by statistical characteristics of broadband signal in telecommunications systems
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Recently there has been stable interest in digital communications systems on the basis of noise-like carriers for increasing the secrecy, noise-immunity and protection from unauthorized access. A broadband communication channel model on the basis of information signal modulation of statistical parameters of noise-like signals was considered.

articleTitle: Methodic of dielectric permeability measurement
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A method of dielectric permeability measurement with permeability type (complex or not) definition is proposed. It is based on the separateness of the input VSWR response for a waveguide segment with dielectric, loaded or as a matched load or as a short circuit lock.

articleTitle: The estimation of HF power pulse effect on FET's noise figure
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A simple method is developed for estimation of HF power pulse effect on FET noise figure under the operating conditions. The method is based on measurement of the evolution of drain current and FET gain. The group of 8 transistors has been measured and analyzed. The estimations show that the noise figure of some FET is rising more than twice under the exposition of HF power pulse of allowable amplitude. It has been shown that the analyzed transistors fall into three groups: (1) transistors which have low sensitivity to input HF pulse power for all allowable amplitudes; (2) transistors which have low sensitivity to input HF pulse power for low amplitude; (3) transistors which are sensitive to input HF pulse power. It is very interesting that the gain of the first group of transistors has also low sensitivity to input HF pulse power.

articleTitle: VHDL-AMS subset for HB simulation
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: This report shows that there is limited subset of VHDL-AMS, which is sufficient to describe pure analog circuits and to propose a simple VHDL-AMS extension to get the advantages of frequency-domain modeling and simulation. That makes possible the usage of the described VHDL-AMS subset as modeling language for the harmonic balance simulator. It allows description of nonlinear dynamic behavior in the time domain, corresponding to nonlinear integro-differential equations. To extend language capabilities, an additional attribute is proposed, which represents the image of a certain quantity in the frequency domain.

articleTitle: The method of solving for the electron transport through systems of rectangular, triangular and parabolic wells and barriers in strong uniform HF electric field
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The steady-state solution of the time-dependence Schrodinger equation in parabolic potential allows generalizing of the method of analysis of electron transport through systems of rectangular and triangular wells and barriers in a strong uniform HF electric field for systems containing parabolic potential. We can obtain a partial answer to the question of the effect of virtual transitions on the observable properties of triple-barrier structures. Virtual transitions can notably affect observable properties of quantum nanostructures.

articleTitle: On the current status of the 'Microwave Technology and Telecommunications' Encyclopedia publishing project. Release of a guide to compiling a glossary
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The paper reports on current developments in implementing the project reported at CriMiCo 2003: publishing a guide to compiling a glossary for the 'Microwave Technology and Telecommunications' Encyclopedia. The encyclopedia structure and the ideology of composing the glossary for the first volume are reviewed. This ideology is based on the Russian Federation educational standards for 16 trades in radio engineering, telecommunications and adjacent profiles. Also discussed are the principles behind selecting the team of writers, issues related to setting up a software suite that would support the editorial project of producing the encyclopedia, as well as networking aspects of the project.

articleTitle: Microwave magnetoelectric devices
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: One of prospective directions of solid-state electronic engineering is to produce new devices on the basis of magnetoelectric materials. The design and application of a new microstrip microwave filter and attenuator based on composite ferrite-piezoelectric resonators are considered.

articleTitle: Transceiver equipment for 110 Mbit/sec speed
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Set, features, and allowed electrical parameters of transceiver equipment for a 100 Mbit/sec link with QAM-16 are presented. The equipment is used with NEWTEC modems.

articleTitle: Peculiarities of H-mode oscillation on the dielectric hemisphere form resonator
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: This work presents new experimental results of H-mode whispering gallery in the hemisphere dielectric resonators. Peculiarity of electromagnetic field structure of H-mode oscillations, which has been experimentally obtained, and excitation of whispering gallery mode oscillations in hemisphere in a form of equatorial belts are presented.

articleTitle: Optimizing cathode operation in MM-wave magnetrons
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Possible ways of optimizing operating conditions for cathodes in millimeter-wave (MM-wave) magnetrons are considered with regard to secondary electron emission processes. An increased secondary emission in combination with a larger interaction space resulting from transition to a hetero-resonator slot-vane system in a non-/spl pi/-mode magnetron or from transition to the electron stream interaction with higher spatial /spl pi/-mode harmonics allows magnetron service life to be increased 5-7 times.

articleTitle: Nonlinear theory of coaxial ubitron microwave amplifier
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: We represent results of investigations of amplification of microwaves in a coaxial ubitron based on high-current relativistic beam.

articleTitle: 95 GHz magnetron with the mean life over 10,000 hours
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: We review problems arising during elaboration of a durable magnetron with main secondary-emissive cathode and auxiliary impregnated thermionic cathode for starting of secondary electron emission.

articleTitle: To the theory of parametrical electron-wave free electron lasers with H-ubitron pumping
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A weak signal theory of the parametrical electron-wave two-stream free electron lasers (FEL) with H-ubitron pumping is created. The analysis for the increment of growth of electromagnetic signal wave is carried out. Perspective of use of the system considered as a powerful low-noise amplifier for mm-IR range is substantiated.

articleTitle: High-efficient converters of circular waveguide higher mode to the mode of simplest structure
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The techniques for gyrotron operation mode conversion into a Gaussian-like wave beam are considered. Experimental results are presented on excitation of the TE12.5 mode (84 GHz) of the circular waveguide, and also on measurement of the wave beam parameters at the converter output when operating with a small level of electromagnetic power. The conversion efficiency is measured to be 97.5%.

articleTitle: Using mobile phones for therapeutic purposes
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The paper discusses the features of mobile phones that determine the nature of radiated EM fields, as well as generated sound and optical vibrations having various spectral characteristics. It is shown that, due to the wide spectrum of vibrations radiated by mobile phones, they may have both negative and positive influences on the human body. Ways and techniques for assessing these influences are suggested. Approaches to design improvements are formulated with the aim of applying the bio-information effects of mobile phones to human organisms, including stress relief.

articleTitle: Longitudinal slot with changing width cut in rectangular waveguide
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Application of longitudinal slots with changing width is considered to be a prospective technique of excitation in the aperture of a slotted radiator cut in the walls of a waveguide structure amplitude and phase distribution which realizes optimal integral radiation characteristics, i.e., radiation far-field pattern and gain. The results of performance examination by the magnetomotive forces method are presented for longitudinal slots with changing width cut in the wide wall of a rectangular waveguide.

articleTitle: Matroid codes decoding
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The main diagram of matroid code decoding is described and theoretically analyzed. An algorithm for matroid (M-) code decoding is described. The complexity of the decoding procedure is analyzed. An optimal decoding algorithm is proposed.

articleTitle: Hall effect sensor in high-power microwave field
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The results of experimental research of the Hall effect sensor in a high intensity microwave field are presented.

articleTitle: The temperature model limits for high electron mobility transistors
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Comparison of temperature and hydrodynamic models for high electron mobility transistors has been carried out. It is shown that the real space transfer in the transistor heterostructures and the strongly energy dependent relaxation times are mostly responsible for the spectacular difference in calculations for HEMT with gate length sufficiently greater than momentum relaxation length. The temperature model may lead to more than 20% error in current and transconductance, beginning from length as long as 0.5/spl mu/, which markedly exceeds the gate length characteristic to modem HEMT. The different models produce a big difference in the drift velocity distribution in the transistor channel, especially when the channel is open and the real space transfer is considerable. The reasons for this effect are as follows: the lateral size of the quantum well is much less than electron momentum relaxation length and electron current flowing transverse to the heterostructure border is really high, even in comparatively low fields. The electron density in the quantum well strongly depends on transverse electron current, which is different for the temperature and hydrodynamic models. For example, in In/sub 0.52/Al/sub 0.48/As-In/sub 0.53/Ga/sub 0.47/As HEMT with 1/spl mu/ gate length, the drift velocity under the gate is 30% more in the temperature model than in the hydrodynamic model.

articleTitle: Spin-polarized electron transport in double-barrier semimagnetic semiconductor nanostructures
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A possibility for creating spin-polarized electron current sources with the help of a double-barrier resonant-tunneling semiconductor nanostructure composed of semimagnetic semiconductor (Zn/sub 1-x/Mn/sub x/Se) layers with different concentrations of manganese ions has been considered.

articleTitle: Temperature compensation of dielectric resonator frequency
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A new way for the thermal compensation of dielectric resonators (DR) is proposed for the DR made of high-quality, but not thermally stable, materials. Thermal stability can be achieved for such DRs in the case when the DR is cut into two parts with a small air slot between them. High Q factor is preserved, as well as a small-sized design. The range of applications of the proposed method is analyzed.

articleTitle: On enhancement of phased array modules based on MMICs by using digital circuits
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The paper describes the essential influence of dispersion parameters of passive and active components on the yield of conventional digital phase shifter and attenuator MMICs. The design of a phased array module insensitive to components' dispersion, having low power consumption and losses, is offered. The design uses a flash-memory IC, analog attenuator, phase shifter and simple DAC.

articleTitle: Mathematical model for calculation of the dielectric resonator characteristics
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: An electrodynamics model of a dielectric resonator presented in this paper is based on application of impedance boundary conditions. The method of accounting for dielectric resonator characteristics is proposed.

articleTitle: Influence of the space charge fields in travelling wave gyrotrons
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Study of a new combined "gyroresonance-gyrotrons" type of interaction for large orbit helical electron beam with rotating wave modes E/sub 11/ and H/sub 11/ in circular corrugated waveguide is carried out. Results of the study have shown that creation of a highly effective TWT with efficiency /spl sim/78% is possible. The estimation of space charge field influence on processes in such a device is given.

articleTitle: Digital phase shifters of the phased antenna arrays based on micromechanical systems
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The discrete phase shifters of phased antenna arrays based on microelectromechanical systems (MEMS) are considered. Due to their extremely small sizes MEMS are suitable to be used up to 100 GHz.

articleTitle: Moon-limb reflection of radio waves during solar eclipse on May 31, 2003
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: During observations of a solar eclipse on May 31, 2003, a zone of brightness was discovered in the Moon limb in a polarization channel of a 13.5-mm wave. This was either due to the reflection of radio waves from its surface or to their refraction in the circumlunar plasma.

articleTitle: Implementation of telecommunication systems using microwave technology in Ukraine
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Presented in This work are the results of research and innovation in the field of creation of National Information-Telecommunication Infrastructure with the use of microwave technology. The concept allows a functionally related structured system of wireless telecommunication media, providing information, navigation and other services, as well as wireless transport and corporate networks, user access networks, etc.

articleTitle: Phase-frequency method of resonant measurement of medium complex permittivity
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The phase variant of the resonant method for complex permittivity measurement of different mediums and application examples are considered.

articleTitle: High electron mobility transistor small signal model
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The small signal model of the ATF-36077 high electron mobility transistor is presented for both packaged and unpackaged cases. The model parameter extraction procedure is presented. It is shown that using the transistor without its package gives the possibility to expand the amplifier frequency range more than twice.

articleTitle: The nanocomposite metal-polymeric materials
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The technology of making metal-polymeric nanocomposites on the basis of the various polymeric matrices was developed. The main electrophysical characteristics of metal-polymeric nanocomposite polyethylene-iron with contents of nanoparticles before 20 mass percent in different frequency ranges were investigated.

articleTitle: Modeling and testing of a 1-stage microwave PIN-diode limiter
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The characteristics of an X-band PIN-diode limiter are presented. A one-dimensional numerical diode model is used for the analysis. The influence of the diode base thickness on the computed and measured power-limiting characteristic and on the power dissipated in the diodes is investigated. The used modeling technique has proved to be an effective tool for the development of microwave control devices.

articleTitle: MOS-transistors on the Si:Ho in the technology of SHF-devices
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: MOSFET-transistors are active elements of SHF integrated circuits. The SHF-transistor parameters optimization method has been designed. It is shown that holmium doping of silicon can be useful in the technology of SHF-devices. The use of silicon doped by holmium allows the improving of the characteristics of MOS structures.

articleTitle: MM-wave low noise amplifier with input power limiter
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The results of the development of a low noise amplifier with an input signal power limiter are presented. The topology and the circuit of the input power limiter are shown and the resulting characteristics are discussed. The application of a GaAs Schottky diode in combination with PIN-diodes has allowed an effective input power limiter to be developed for a MM-wave low noise amplifier.

articleTitle: Microstrip harmonics filter for 2270 MHz frequency
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A microstrip harmonic filter for suppression of the second and third signal harmonics at frequency of 2270 MHz, implemented with Flan material, has been introduced.

articleTitle: Wideband antennas with wide-angle scanning
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: With the development of radio systems and wide applications of phased antenna-arrays, the problem arises of frequency bandwidth widening with the same or bigger scanning sector. Variants of construction of an antenna with electrical and commutation scanning are presented. Dependency of the directivity characteristics on the sector of scanning and frequency are considered.

articleTitle: National Communication and Broadcasting Satellite System
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The total characteristic of the National Communication and Broadcasting Satellite System (NCBSS) is shown and the task list for the NCBSS design is given. Some technical solutions, from different communication and broadcasting system architectures to particular technologies (SiGe, SO, SIP etc.) are discussed. Attention is drawn to the necessity to solve domestic producer problems and some economic and organization issues.

articleTitle: Vector network analyzer for short-wave part of millimeter waves
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Some features of vector network analyzer design with improved metrological parameters are reviewed.

articleTitle: Communication transceiver of I-band with FM carrier
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Development data of an I-band solid-state transceiver with frequency modulation (FM) of carrier and increased radiated power, responsivity, carrier stability, and medium frequency is given. The spectrum parameters of an FM signal are given.

articleTitle: Dielectric image guide as basic electrodynamic structure for high-performance radiation systems design
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The wave guiding properties and conditions to obtain a special field structure in a high-performance radiation system based on one variety of strip dielectric waveguide, called an image waveguide, are examined. The investigations show the possibility of special field pattern imaging, which allows forecasting the creation of highly effective radiation systems in the millimeter wave frequency band.

articleTitle: A compact 8.2 and 13.5 mm-wave radio source discovered during solar eclipse on May 31, 2003
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: During observations of a solar eclipse on May 31, 2003, using an RT-22 large radio telescope of the Crimean Astrophysical Observatory, an 8.2 and 13.5 mm-wave compact radio source with an angular size of about 3" was discovered on the solar disk. The radiation brightness temperature was about 3.18/spl times/10/sup 6/ K at 13.5 mm and 1.6/spl times/10/sup 6/ K at 8.2 mm.

articleTitle: Reflectarrays design based on CAD
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The package of applied programs for analysis and synthesis of microstrip reflective type antenna arrays (RAA) is presented. Algorithms for analysis and synthesis are given. Interface and operation methods are described. This software package is applicable for decision of the broad class of microwave antenna engineering problems.

articleTitle: Experimental investigations of the middle-latitude ionospheric D-region response to distant rocket launches
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Changes in electron density in the middle-latitude D-region of the ionosphere have been experimentally investigated during distant launches of different types of rockets. Short-term pulsing disturbances of the electron density in the lower ionosphere have been discovered. To explain these effects, the hypothesis has been suggested for conditioned pulsing electron streams arriving into the lower ionosphere from the magnetosphere and having the energies of /spl sim/10/sup 2/-10 keV and stream densities of p /spl sim/10/sup 8/-10/sup 9/ m/sup -2/s/sup -1/.

articleTitle: Form optimization of the UWB pulses in radar technology for accuracy increasing of angular measurements
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: This work describes how the angular coordinates measurement precision of hardly noticeable radar targets increases due to the choice of an optimum form of UWB signal. The optimization, which has been carried out on the basis of known reflecting properties of the targets, allows the choice of the necessary ratio between maximal value of UWB signal and width of antenna pattern.

articleTitle: Avalanche injection instability and low break down voltage in multilayer structures
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: It is shown for the first time that, in n-i-n structures under certain conditions, instability with an S-type I-V curve connected with avalanche ionization leads to current pinching, and, finally, local destruction of the structures. The threshold voltage characteristic to the instability has, as a rule, a much less unstable condition than U/sub 0/. The instability threshold voltage is, as a rule, much less than the breakdown voltage of both the dielectric of the same thickness and the expected breakdown of the n-i-n structure.

articleTitle: Microwave plasmochemical deposition of the planar waveguide structures on the base of silica glass
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Planar optical waveguides (POW) on silicon and silica substrates have applications for integrated sensors, optical communications and MOEMS-technologies. Quartz-quartz planar waveguides with fluorine cladding and pure silica glass core were produced by the microwave plasmochemical deposition method at low pressure.

articleTitle: Radiolocating parameters for sphere covered with nonlinear substance layer
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Nonlinear biharmonic electromagnetic field scattering on a metal sphere covered by a substance with nonlinear characteristics is considered. Nonlinear material equations given as Taylor series are used here.

articleTitle: S-band low-noise amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The characteristics of S-band low-noise amplifiers for use in space communication systems, with noise temperature not exceeding 60/spl deg/K, are presented. LNA calculation methods, development and design have been carried out for various operating conditions. An optimum design has been developed, permitting multipurpose applications, as part of various equipment, and as separate RF units.

articleTitle: Calculation of E01 mode filter for the goffered wave-guide interval
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: On the basis of the strict electrodynamic theory in view of raised supercritical cut-off mode, the study of influence of geometrical parameters on strip properties of the filter as a part of a round periodically offered wave-guide was carried out.

articleTitle: A series of diplexers for 2-cm band
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Modern radio communication systems need new electronic components. The article presents a series of diplexers developed for new communication facilities. The construction and parameters of the developed 2-cm waveband diplexers are presented.

articleTitle: Method for automation of planar multiunit antenna arrays design
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: We present a method for automation of planar multiunit phased antenna array (PAA) systems. The method is based on the optimized search method to find the extreme of the criterion function, i.e., to find the minimum reflection coefficient of the electromagnetic wave fed into the aperture of the PAA. An application example of the method for broadband scanning PAA with waveguide of arbitrary cross section is shown.

articleTitle: Frequency selection for HF long-haul radiocommunication in emergency situations
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Combined use of satellite communications and HF radiocommunication is realized often, where HF radio is applied mostly and only in special cases is expensive satellite communication used. The deficiency in HF radio is that it has limited capacity of operating frequencies. It is shown that approximate values of HF operating long-haul HF radio frequencies can be chosen with use of prognosis of least applicable frequencies.

articleTitle: Metrological performance analysis of microwave noise meter
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: In our microwave frequency equipment verification and testing measuring laboratory, calibration methods and algorithms are being developed for 3-mm and 8-mm wavelength range microwave noise meters. It is necessary to investigate the metrological performance of microwave noise meters, possible measuring uncertainty sources, and their influence on the total value of uncertainty. This paper presents the results of uncertainty sources analysis of microwave signal noise amplitude measurement.

articleTitle: Method of frequency planning of radio-relay network using GIS technologies
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: A method for frequency planning of radio-relay networks was created using GIS ArcView 8.x. Calculation of radio-relay line-of-sight (LoS) is based on the ITU recommendation. The test calculations are carried out using digital cards.

articleTitle: The multi-resonance technique for curve processing
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: This article describes the algorithm of a high-efficiency technique for multi-resonance curve processing. The technique is useful for determination of the resonance characteristics of any resonance type experimental curves. This method, as shown in real and numerical experiments, assures higher accuracy than traditional methods, which are based on experimental data smoothing.

articleTitle: A low-noise L-band modular amplifier
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The development of a low-noise input modular amplifier for L-band is presented. The module consists of a two-circuit parametric amplifier and a quasi-optical pumping oscillator. At 60-65 GHz, an amplification factor of 17 dB has been obtained at the half power level and a bandwidth of 1.2 GHz. The noise temperature is no more than 550 K when the quasi-optical IMPATT-diode oscillator is used as a pumping source.

articleTitle: Frequency selection of electromagnetic waves by rough mirror
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The physical basis of frequency selection is considered for electromagnetic waves, reflected by a rough metal surface. The paper investigates the interdependence of metallic surface parameters and the frequency selection properties for reflected electromagnetic radiation with regard to dissipating IR radiation on millimeter-wave antenna mirrors. The coincidence of experimental and calculated data on the spectral properties of a millimeter-wave antenna mirror in the IR frequency band is obtained.

articleTitle: Experimental W-band radar for missile guidance systems improvement
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The results of an experimental examination of small dimension pulse coherent W-band radar are presented. This radar is the basis for an all-weather and all-time coordinator design. The results confirm the real possibility of creating a basic W-band radar coordinator for 100 mm missile guidance systems.

articleTitle: Microwave resonance therapy - the basis technology of quantum medicine
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Quantum medicine is the medical application of the new notions about the nature of life, which are given by physics of the alive. In accordance with these notions any free functioning alive object is sited on the fourth step of the nature quantum ladder, i.e. one is the whole macroscopic quantum mechanics entity. In the scope of this approach "the health organism" is associated with the ground state of the alive in its potential wellbeing and disease as a metastable state. The standard resonance discharge of metastable state to the ground one which is usually realized in three previous steps of quantum ladder (nuclear, atomic and molecular) in the case of the alive conforms to the treatment with the technologies of the microwave resonance therapy (MRT).

articleTitle: The nature of dielectric permittivity electric control at microwaves
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: The control of dielectric permittivity (/spl epsiv/) by the bias electric field (E/sub b/) at microwaves, and its application in a phase shifter has 40-year history (Gevorgian, S., IEEE Microwave Theor. Tech., vol.49, no.11, p.2117-23, 2001). However, only recently has ferroelectric thin film processing become good enough, and tuned microwave devices based on paraelectric films can now be competitive with the microwave ferrite and PIN diode. Nevertheless, there are still some problems with ferroelectric film microwave applications. Microwave tunable devices (like phase shifters or filters) need low loss dielectric material with permittivity /spl epsiv/(E) which can be controlled by an acceptable voltage. The main mechanisms of electric control of /spl epsiv//sub ef/ are discussed. It is supposed that the most effective low loss is to use a "microwave dielectric-air gap" system which is controlled by a fast electrostrictive actuator.

articleTitle: Distributions of amplitude and phase fluctuations in tilt ionospheric sounding signals
publicationTitle: 2004 14th International Crimean Conference "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology" (IEEE Cat. No.04EX843)
abstract: Determining angles of arrival for shortwave radio beams is of great practical significance in the ionosphere research. The impact of amplitude and phase fluctuations in tilt ionospheric sounding signals on the accuracy of determining angles of arrival in small-base antenna systems is discussed. Amplitude and phase fluctuation distributions of tilt ionospheric sounding signals are analysed for various shortwave radio links and propagation conditions. Comparison to known model distributions are carried out. Model distributions for amplitude and phase difference fluctuations in the case of strong scattering are proposed. The available data allows for the influence of phase fluctuations on the accuracy of defining angles of arrival in small-base systems to be estimated.
